TRAINER_AARON.name: Aaron
messages: The savage tide in this area serves to\nmake us stronger than ever.{be01}
I willingly concede defeat.

We will return for more training at
Meteor Falls.{be01}
If you’d like, you should go, too.
It will definitely toughen you up!

TRAINER_ABIGAIL_1.name: Abigail
messages: The triathlon is hard in the extreme.{be01}\nYou have to complete the three events\nof swimming, cycling, and running.{be01}
Pokémon battles are hard, too!
I’m exhausted, so I need a break.\nIt’s important to get proper rest.

TRAINER_ABIGAIL_2.name: Grunt
messages: Aiyiyi…\nMy pride as a Team Magma member…
If you suffer from chills, you should\njoin Team Magma.

TRAINER_ABIGAIL_3.name: Grunt
messages: I don’t have a bone to pick with you.\nI’m just following orders!{be01}
I may have lost, but…

We dug up something beyond belief!
And, we got the Blue Orb!{be01}
All that’s left is for our leader to…
Fufufu… Fwahahaha!

TRAINER_ABIGAIL_4.name: Grunt
messages: Oh, no!\nYou’re not to be trusted at all!

Listen to me.
Team Magma is right!{be01}
Don’t listen to Team Aqua.
Don’t believe their lies!

TRAINER_ABIGAIL_5.name: Tabitha
messages: Taken down again…\nHehe…
…And while you wasted time with me,\nMaxie should have awakened Groudon…

TRAINER_AIDAN.name: Aidan
messages: Bird Pokémon have excellent vision.\nThey spot prey from great heights.{be01}
Whew… I give up.

There’re lots of diving spots in
the sea around here.{be01}
You can spot them easily from the sky
because of their darker color.

TRAINER_AISHA.name: Aisha
messages: Concentrate on getting the win.\nThat’s how I battle!{be01}
I don’t waste any time being angry\nover a loss--I would rather train.
I think that if you worry about losing,\nyou’re more likely to lose.

TRAINER_ALAN.name: Alan
messages: I don’t get it. What would anyone want\nwith a house this bizarre?{be01}
I don’t get it.\nHow did I lose?
I don’t get it.\nHow many traps are in this house?{be01}\nYou may be the one to solve that.

TRAINER_ALBERT.name: Albert
messages: I didn’t come all this way to lose now.\nThat possibility doesn’t exist!{be01}
Impossible…\nI lost?
I lost here…{be01}\nThat means I lack the qualifications\nto become the Champion…

TRAINER_ALBERTO.name: Alberto
messages: Even in defeat, Bird Pokémon are cool!

I gather Bird Pokémon feathers that
scatter during battles.{be01}
I’m going to make a hat with
Bird Pokémon feathers.

TRAINER_ALEX.name: Alex
messages: Okeydokey! That’s enough rest, gang!\nIt’s time for a match!{be01}
Tuckered out again…
My Bird Pokémon get tired quickly after\na long flight…

TRAINER_ALEXA.name: Alexa
messages: We’ve been working so hard to mount\na Pokémon League challenge…{be01}\nWe can’t afford to lose now!{be01}
Oh!\nHow could this happen?!
After all I’ve done to get here,\nI won’t give up after one setback.

TRAINER_ALEXIA.name: Alexia
messages: The higher the Defense, the more\nreckless I can be in attack.{be01}
Our defenses weren’t enough…

TRAINER_ALEXIS.name: Alexis
messages: Whoever wins will get through here\nfirst. That’s the feeling I get.{be01}
Oh!\nWell, go ahead, then!
You’re solving all the puzzles in the\nTrick House. That’s the feeling I get.

TRAINER_ALICE.name: Alice
messages: Are you properly protected against\nthe sun?{be01}
Ouch, ouch, ouch!
Cheeks are the most prone to burning!

TRAINER_ALIX.name: Alix
messages: Our eyes met!\nThere’s no getting away now!{be01}
Gah!\nNot bad!
Oh, well.\nI think I will Teleport home.

TRAINER_ALLEN.name: Allen
messages: Did you just become a Trainer?\nWe’re both beginners!{be01}
I called you because I thought\nI could beat you…
I haven’t won once yet…\nI wish I would win soon…

TRAINER_ALLISON.name: Allison
messages: I’m in the middle of a triathlon,\nbut, sure, why don’t we battle?{be01}
I was sure I’d win!

TRAINER_ALVARO.name: Alvaro
messages: I ever so closely watched you coming!{be01}
This outcome I didn’t see coming…

Well, anyway, we both picked a weird
place to get acquainted.{be01}
As one weirdo to another,
let’s do our best!

TRAINER_ALYSSA.name: Alyssa
messages: I fell off Cycling Road…{be01}\nI’ll get over my embarrassment by\nbattling with you!{be01}
Oops!\nI ended up losing!
Falling… Losing…\nThis is so humiliating for me!

TRAINER_AMY_AND_LIV_1.name: Amy & Liv
messages: Amy: I’m Amy.\nAnd this is my little sister Liv.{be00}\nWe battle together!{be01}
Amy: Uh-oh, we lost.{be01}\nLiv: Oh, we lost, big sister…
Amy: You have to think about all\nkinds of things when you’re battling{be00}\nagainst two Trainers.
Amy: Uh-oh, you have only one\nPokémon with you.{be00}\nYou can’t battle us like that.
Liv: We battle together as one\nteam.{be01}
Liv: We work perfectly together,\nme and my big sister…{be01}\nBut we still lost…
Liv: If you want to battle us,\nyou have to have two Pokémon!{be00}\nIt’s not fair if you don’t!

TRAINER_ANDREA.name: Andrea
messages: I’ll show you the sublime techniques\nI learned from our Leader Juan!{be01}
Please forgive me, Juan…
Watch what happens if you crack all\nthe floor tiles.

TRAINER_ANDRES_1.name: Andres
messages: I’m convinced that the sea keeps\nsecrets from us.{be01}
Yes…\nI am no good at battling…
I’m sure there are many secrets to be\ndiscovered in the world’s seas.{be01}\nI mean to find them all!

TRAINER_ANDREW.name: Andrew
messages: Gah! My fishing line’s all snarled up!\nI’m getting frustrated and mean!{be00}\nThat’s it! Battle me!{be01}
Gah! Lost it!\nI’m even more annoyed now!
Gah, I’m still boiling mad…\nGrrrrr…

TRAINER_ANDY.name: Keegan
messages: Play with fire, and be burned…

Your skill is real…
But our Leader Flannery is strong.{be01}
If you don’t watch yourself, you’ll be
burned seriously.

TRAINER_ANETTE.name: Naomi
messages: Oh, you’re such an adorable Trainer.\nWould you like to have tea?{be00}\nOr would you rather battle?{be01}
I see.\nYou’re the active sort.

A world cruise on a luxury liner has its
charms, I must say…{be01}
But, I will admit there is an appealing
side to touring Hoenn by ferry.

TRAINER_ANGELICA.name: Angelica
messages: Me, Pokémon, and my parasol…{be01}\nIf any one of them is missing,\nthe picture of beauty will be ruined.{be01}
You’ve completely ruined my beauty…
A parasol wouldn’t suit you at all.{be01}\nWhy, something like this would only\nget in your way.

TRAINER_ANGELINA.name: Angelina
messages: Have you made your Pokémon evolve\nvery much?{be01}
Oh, I see.\nThat’s good to know.
Some Pokémon change so much when\nthey evolve, it’s startling!

TRAINER_ANGELO.name: Angelo
messages: I love shiny things!{be01}
Oh…\nMy eyes are frazzled…
Mauville Gym’s Wattson has a shiny\nforehead. It makes me happy!

TRAINER_ANNA_AND_MEG_1.name: Anna & Meg
messages: Anna: I’m with my pretty junior student\npartner. I have to do good!{be01}

Anna: I’m with my pretty junior student
partner! Let me win!{be01}
Meg: Oh, no!
I’m sorry, Anna! I let you down…
Anna: Your Pokémon have some good\ncombinations.{be01}\nI’d say you’re second only to us!
Anna: If you want to battle us,\nbring two Pokémon with you.
Meg: I’m going to tag up with my super\nsenior student partner and beat you!{be01}
Meg: I dragged Anna down…\nIf I didn’t, she would have won!
Meg: Do you only have one Pokémon?\nWe can’t battle with you, then.{be01}\nWe want to have a 2-on-2 battle.

TRAINER_ANNA_AND_MEG_2.name: Hailey
messages: I can’t swim, so I’m pretending\nto swim.{be01}
I thought so!\nI didn’t think we could win.
When I learn how to swim, I think\nmy Pokémon will become tougher.

TRAINER_ANNA_AND_MEG_3.name: Chandler
messages: Tadaah! See?\nMy inner tube’s round!{be01}
Oh, oh!\nToo bad!
After I showed you my round inner\ntube, too…

TRAINER_ANNA_AND_MEG_4.name: Kaleb
messages: When cute Pokémon help each other…\nYou won’t see a more adorable sight!{be01}
Have you no compassion or pity?
Okay, okay, you’ve done the best you\ncould, my pretties.

TRAINER_ANNA_AND_MEG_5.name: Joseph
messages: Okay! Full-throttle time! If you can’t\ngroove, you get left behind!{be01}
You got into the groove all right…
This isn’t going to bring me down!\nLosing has made me a better man!

TRAINER_ANNIKA.name: Annika
messages: I can battle with really rare Pokémon\nif you’d like.{be01}
Oh, there now! Did you have a good look\nat my Pokémon?

I came to this Gym because Juan
praised me for my darling Pokémon.{be01}
Oh, if only I’d met Juan years ago
when I was younger…

TRAINER_ANTHONY.name: Anthony
messages: Yo, you!\nCan you keep up with my speed?{be01}
Crash and burn!
Speed alone won’t let me win at Pokémon.\nI need to reconsider this…

TRAINER_ARCHIE.name: Archie
messages: What?!\nI lost to a mere child like you?!

TRAINER_ARCHIE_2.name: Archie
messages: What?!\nI lost to a mere child like you?!

TRAINER_ARCHIE_3.name: Leah
messages: You are an unfamiliar sight…\nDepart before anything befalls you!{be01}
Hmm…\nYou’re durable.

Our family has been Trainers here
since my great-grandmother’s time…{be01}
It is my duty to protect this
mountain…

TRAINER_ASHLEY.name: Ashley
messages: Winona taught me personally!\nYou can’t beat me easily!{be01}
I was beaten…
Thanks to Winona, the people of\nFortree can live without fear.

TRAINER_ATHENA.name: Athena
messages: We should have a slow and methodical\nmatch.{be01}
You didn’t give me the chance to\ndo any strategizing.
When I’m surrounded by the blue sea\nand sky, it feels as if time slows down.

TRAINER_ATSUSHI.name: Atsushi
messages: Teacher…\nPlease watch over my progress!{be01}
Teacher…\nPlease forgive me!
Until I improve, my teacher, who rests\nhere, will never find true peace…

TRAINER_AURON.name: Auron
messages: Hey! Was it you throwing garbage\ninto the sea?{be01}
Oh, you weren’t throwing trash into\nthe sea.

I found an unsightly bottle bobbing
in the waves earlier.{be01}
It angers me that someone would
pollute the sea!

TRAINER_AUSTIN.name: Dominik
messages: Swimming the deep blue sea…\nIt feels the greatest!{be01}
I lost…\nNow I’m feeling blue…
Why is the sea blue?{be01}\nI learned about that at the Museum in\nSlateport, but I forgot.

TRAINER_AUSTINA.name: Austina
messages: I can’t swim without my inner tube,\nbut I won’t lose at Pokémon!{be01}
Did I lose because I have an inner\ntube?
My inner tube is a fashion item.\nI can’t be seen without it.

TRAINER_AUTUMN.name: Autumn
messages: I climb this hill every day.\nI have confidence in my strength!{be01}
Hmm…\nWhat went wrong?
What is that odd rock protrusion\na little up the hill from here?

TRAINER_AXLE.name: Axle
messages: I’m trying to relieve my stress.\nDon’t come along and stress me out!{be01}
I hope Flannery flames you good!
Haaah… Whew…{be01}\nIf you spend too much time buried in\nhot sand, it tuckers you out…

TRAINER_BARNY.name: Barny
messages: I’m a Fisherman, but also a Trainer.\nI’m raising the Pokémon I caught.{be01}
I thought I was doing okay in my\ntraining…
I couldn’t win by training Pokémon\nwhile I fished…{be01}\nWas I doing things in half measures?

TRAINER_BARRY.name: Barry
messages: Swimming is a full-body workout!\nYou will get fit!{be01}
I admit it!\nYou win!
Thanks to my daily swimming routine…\nLook! Feast your eyes on this physique!

TRAINER_BEAU.name: Beau
messages: Wearing these Go-Goggles makes me\nfeel like a superhero.{be00}\nRight now, nobody can beat me!{be01}
I can’t win on spirit alone…
I’m going to be a real hero one day.\nI’m going to work harder to make me{be00}\nand my Pokémon stronger.

TRAINER_BECK.name: Beck
messages: I came all the way out here with my\nBird Pokémon.{be01}
You…\nYou’re stunningly cool!
I’d like to go back to Fortree,\nbut I’ve grown to like this place, too.

TRAINER_BECKY.name: Becky
messages: I heard there are fossils to be found\nin the desert. Where could they be?{be01}
I came up short…
If they can find fossils in the desert,\nit must have been a sea before.

TRAINER_BEN.name: Ben
messages: This Gym’s got puzzles!\nIsn’t it fun?{be01}
It’s no fun to lose…
Wattson says he likes setting up\nlittle traps with switches.

TRAINER_BENJAMIN_1.name: Benjamin
messages: Don’t panic if your Bike’s going fast!{be01}
I shouldn’t panic during Pokémon\nbattles…
There’s no need to panic or stress.\nTake it easy. There’s plenty of time.

TRAINER_BENJAMIN_2.name: Grunt
messages: Yeah, I think we are doing something\nwrong somehow.
You know, losing to you cleared my mind.{be01}\nThe next time I see our leader,\nI’m going to ask him about what we do.

TRAINER_BENJAMIN_3.name: Grunt
messages: I guess it’s impossible to win if one\ndoesn’t have a calm mind…
I wonder if Groudon even has a tail?

TRAINER_BENJAMIN_4.name: Grunt
messages: Fuhahaha!\nSoon! Very soon!{be00}\nOur grand objective will be achieved!{be01}
Grrr…\nI’ve come so far, but now this?
Maxie, sir!\nAn intruder is headed your way!

TRAINER_BENJAMIN_5.name: Grunt
messages: You’re not finished yet!\nYou’re not getting by me easily!{be01}
Was I that easy to knock down?
C-come on, one more match…

TRAINER_BENNY.name: Benny
messages: Maybe I could get my Bird Pokémon\nto fly over the wall…{be01}
Gwaaah! I blew it!
Ehehehe… I guess I lost because\nI was trying to cheat.

TRAINER_BERKE.name: Berke
messages: Your power…\nYou’re the real deal.

TRAINER_BERNIE_1.name: Bernie
messages: If you’re lighting a campfire,\nmake sure you have water handy.{be01}
Thanks for dousing my fire!

You really do have to be careful with
any sort of fire in a forest.{be01}
Don’t ever underestimate the power
of fire.

TRAINER_BERNIE_2.name: Lilith
messages: Ufufu…\nAre you stumbling around in the dark?{be01}
Oh, you…\nI don’t want to know you!
You deserve to stay lost and end up\nback at the entrance again!

TRAINER_BERNIE_3.name: Cristian
messages: If you mean to pass, it has to be\nthrough me!{be01}
Grrrrr!\nVastly overpowered!
You win!\nGo after that Badge!

TRAINER_BERNIE_4.name: Sylvia
messages: Even at the risk of life, I will win\nthis battle!{be01}
What you do…\nIt horrifies me…
How dare you beat me…{be01}\nIt won’t be my fault if something\nhorrible befalls you…

TRAINER_BERNIE_5.name: Leonardo
messages: I couldn’t even swim last year,\nbut now I’m a decent Swimmer.{be01}\nI think I’m capable of anything now.{be01}
Sheesh, getting greedy didn’t do\na thing for me.

If you practice at something,
you will get better at it.{be01}
You’re young--don’t be afraid to
try all sorts of things!

TRAINER_BETH.name: Beth
messages: Did you want to battle me?\nSure, I’ll go with you!{be01}
I wasn’t good enough for you.
I think you’re going to keep getting\nbetter. I’ll go for it, too!

TRAINER_BETHANY.name: Bethany
messages: When I’m with my Pokémon, the time\nflies by before you can say, “Oops!”{be01}
Oops!
I wish I could forget about lost causes\nbefore I can manage an “Oops!”

TRAINER_BEVERLY.name: Beverly
messages: My body feels lighter in the water.\nIt’s as if I’ve gotten slimmer!{be01}
I’m floating…

Your body weight is reduced to just
one tenth in the water.{be01}
That would make me…
Whoops! I’m not telling you my weight!

TRAINER_BIANCA.name: Bianca
messages: Did you come from Mauville?\nThen you should be full of energy!{be01}
Ooh lala!\nThat’s a lot to take!
This road here…\nYou have quite a ways to travel.

TRAINER_BILLY.name: Billy
messages: Leaving footprints in the sand is\nso fun!{be01}
Waah! I got sand in my runners!\nThey’re all gritty!
I want to leave my footprints in\nthe sand everywhere, but they{be00}\ndisappear quickly…

TRAINER_BLAKE.name: Blake
messages: My Pokémon battling skills are out\nof sync, too!

TRAINER_BRANDEN.name: Branden
messages: I’ll give you some of my sandwich\nif you’ll lose.{be01}
Tch! I thought a sandwich would be\nenough of a bribe…
My Sandshrew loves eating\nmy sandwiches.

TRAINER_BRANDI.name: Brandi
messages: Let me demonstrate the power\nhidden within a Psychic Pokémon!{be01}
Astonishing!
Psychic Pokémon are complex.\nYou should try catching some.

TRAINER_BRANDON_1.name: Jeffrey
messages: … … … … … …\n… … … … … …{be00}\nWant to battle?{be01}
Lost it…
… … … … … …\n… … … … … …{be00}\nI’ll try harder…

TRAINER_BRANDON_2.name: Nate
messages: Hohoho.{be01}\nYou need me to show you how tenacious\nthe Psychic type can be.{be01}
Oh! My, my!\nYour battle style is fantastic!
I… I don’t let defeat rattle m-me,\nhowever b-badly.

TRAINER_BRANDON_3.name: Kathleen
messages: Let me show you a perfectly awful,\nhorrifying time!{be01}
N-nooooo!
Your vitality is contagious!\nGet away from me quickly!

TRAINER_BRANDON_4.name: Clifford
messages: I may be past my prime, but I suggest\nyou not patronize me.{be01}
Ah, you overflow with the power\nof youth!
It seems that I could not overcome\nyour youthful energy.

TRAINER_BRANDON_5.name: Nicholas
messages: Wroooar! Have a taste of my super\nPokémon hard-battling power!{be01}
Oh!\nDone in!
All right! I think I’ll develop a special\ninvincible Pokémon power next.

TRAINER_BRAWLY.name: Brawly
messages: I can see your talent becoming a giant\nwave to cause a storm of astonishment{be00}\namong Trainers one day!

TRAINER_BRAWLY_1.name: Brawly

TRAINER_BRAXTON.name: Braxton
messages: Oh, you’re worthy, all right!
You did your Badges proud in that\nmatch!

TRAINER_BRENDA.name: Brenda
messages: Hello, kiddo!\nWant a battle with me?{be01}
Oh, noooooh!
I love frolicking with Pokémon in\nthe sea like this!

TRAINER_BRENDEN.name: Brenden
messages: I’ll show you the gumption of\na sailing man!{be01}
How’d this happen?\nIt’s not like me to lose this way!
Oh, aye! You’re worthy of seeing\nour Gym Leader.

TRAINER_BRENT.name: Brent
messages: We’re the Mimic Circle!\nWe Mimic what you do!{be01}
Whoopsie!\nI lost!
What’s so good about mimicry?{be01}\nFufufu…\nYou’ll never understand…

TRAINER_BRIANNA.name: Brianna
messages: Giggle…\nYour grim look is so charming.{be01}
Oh, dear.\nI went much too easy on you.
You couldn’t lay a finger on Juan,\nI’m sure. Giggle…

TRAINER_BRICE.name: Brice
messages: I lost!\nHahahaha!
Hahahahaha! Something flew up my nose!\nHahahaha-hatchoo!

TRAINER_BRIDGET.name: Bridget
messages: The Pokémon Gym of the highest level\nin the Hoenn region…{be01}\nThat’s the Sootopolis Gym.{be01}
What a high level you are!

TRAINER_BROOKE_1.name: Brooke
messages: Oh, your Pokémon look like serious\nactors.{be00}\nI have to ask you for an engagement.{be01}
They didn’t just look strong,\nthey are strong!
I thought I was raising my Pokémon\ndiligently, but, oh no, there is still{be00}\nmuch to be done.

messages: I climb this hill every day.\nI have confidence in my strength!{be01}
Hmm…\nWhat went wrong?
What is that odd rock protrusion\na little up the hill from here?

TRAINER_BROOKE_3.name: Quincy
messages: What is the Victory Road?\nI’ll tell you if you win!{be01}
Okay!\nWell done!

TRAINER_BROOKE_4.name: Katelynn
messages: I have nothing to say to anyone\nthat’s come this far. Come on!{be01}
This is a disgrace…
Humph, go right on ahead.\nSee if I care.

TRAINER_BROOKE_5.name: Demetrius
messages: Waaah!\nI’ve been found! …Huh?{be01}
Oh, you’re not my mom.
I’m in trouble with my mom, so I ran.\nKeep it a secret where I am!

TRAINER_BRYAN.name: Bryan
messages: How tough are you?\nWe shall expose that secret!{be01}
Oh! Your strength!\nIt is shrouded in mystery!
This desert hoards mysteries in\nits shifting sands!

TRAINER_BRYANT.name: Bryant
messages: I caught hot Pokémon in Fiery Path!\nTake a look!{be01}
What a bumpy ride that was!
I like the way you battle.\nIt has a certain flair to it.

TRAINER_BYRON.name: Aidan
messages: Bird Pokémon have excellent vision.\nThey spot prey from great heights.{be01}
Whew… I give up.

There’re lots of diving spots in
the sea around here.{be01}
You can spot them easily from the sky
because of their darker color.

TRAINER_CALE.name: Cale
messages: Of course I lost!\nI’m holding stuff in both hands!

I bought too much stuff at
the Lilycove Dept. Store.{be01}
It’s up the road from here.
I wish I had a Bag like yours.

TRAINER_CALEB.name: Camden
messages: I can see it in your face.\nYou want to challenge me.{be01}
Awawawawawa…
A well-played match leaves me feeling\nrefreshed and serene.

TRAINER_CALLIE.name: Callie
messages: If you don’t pay attention,\nyou could get hurt!{be01}
Ouch!\nI was the one to get hurt.
I wonder… Should I evolve my Pokémon?\nThey’re cute the way they are, though.

TRAINER_CALVIN_1.name: Calvin
messages: If you have Pokémon with you, then\nyou’re an official Pokémon Trainer!{be00}\nYou can’t say no to my challenge!{be01}
Arrgh, I lost…\nI should have trained mine more…
Listen, you. If you’re strong,\nyou should have told me before!

TRAINER_CALVIN_2.name: Grunt
messages: Arrgh!\nTaken down!

I won’t tell you after all.
You’ll find out when you get there!{be01}
It’d be better if you saved surprises
to the end, don’t you think?

TRAINER_CALVIN_3.name: Grunt
messages: Hold it right there!{be01}\nYou don’t really expect me to keep\nmy trap shut and let you waltz by me?{be01}
Ooh wow!\nI concede!
Maybe it would’ve been better if I did\njust let you go unchallenged…

TRAINER_CALVIN_4.name: Grunt
messages: Ahah!\nAn intruder!{be01}
Graaah!
I’ve already lost.{be01}\nDo I really need to keep running\naround in a circle?

TRAINER_CALVIN_5.name: Grunt
messages: Oh, oh!\nAn intruder!{be01}
Mutter…
Actually, I’m no expert at battling…

TRAINER_CAMDEN.name: Camden
messages: I can see it in your face.\nYou want to challenge me.{be01}
Awawawawawa…
A well-played match leaves me feeling\nrefreshed and serene.

TRAINER_CAMERON_1.name: Cameron
messages: Being a psychic is about willpower.{be01}\nI’ve willed myself not to lose to\nanyone. That makes me strong!{be01}
I feel sad…
Being a psychic is about willpower.\nI thought I wouldn’t lose to you…

TRAINER_CAMERON_2.name: Grunt
messages: As promised, we’ve come for\nthe rocket fuel!{be01}
Ran out of fuel…
Don’t think you’re on a roll just\nbecause you’ve beaten me!

TRAINER_CAMERON_3.name: Grunt
messages: The rocket fuel the Space Center has\nin storage--that’s what we’re after.{be01}\nWe mean to take every last bit of it!{be01}
Please, can you spare some fuel?\nEven a chintzy cup will do!

What are we going to do with
the rocket fuel?{be01}
How would I know?
Ask our leader upstairs!

TRAINER_CAMERON_4.name: Grunt
messages: I lost!\nBut!
It’s too soon to be relieved!\nI’m up next!

TRAINER_CAMERON_5.name: Grunt
messages: I lost, too!\nBut!
I bet you want to take a break.\nBut I’m not about to let you do that!

TRAINER_CAMRON.name: Camron
messages: I’m in the middle of a triathlon,\nbut I’m nowhere near tired!{be01}
That exhausted me…
I still have swimming and running left\nto do after this.{be01}\nAm I going to be okay?

TRAINER_CARLEE.name: Carlee
messages: The sunlight seems to be more harsh\nin this area.{be01}
I couldn’t see very well because of\nthe sun’s glare.
I should go back soon.\nI need to reapply my sunscreen.

TRAINER_CARLOS.name: Lorenzo
messages: I’ll check your Pokémon and see if\nthey’re fit for the outdoors.{be01}
With Pokémon that strong, you’re in\nno danger of needing rescue!
To travel wherever your heart desires\nwith Pokémon…{be00}\nThat’s the joy of being a Trainer.

TRAINER_CARMEN.name: Austina
messages: I can’t swim without my inner tube,\nbut I won’t lose at Pokémon!{be01}
Did I lose because I have an inner\ntube?
My inner tube is a fashion item.\nI can’t be seen without it.

TRAINER_CAROL.name: Carol
messages: When you’re out on a picnic, why,\nyou simply have to sing!{be00}\nCome on, sing with me!{be01}
Oh, you’re so strong!
It doesn’t matter if you’re good or bad\nat singing or Pokémon.{be01}\nIf you have the most fun, you win!

TRAINER_CAROLINA.name: Carolina
messages: I take huge pride in my Pokémon.\nWe’ll show you one speedy battle!{be01}
That wasn’t cute at all.
Since I’m at sea like this, I wouldn’t\nmind putting on a pink, frilly swimsuit…

TRAINER_CAROLINE.name: Caroline
messages: You must be getting a little tired.{be01}
No signs of tiring at all!
Victory Road and the Pokémon League\nare long and grueling challenges.{be00}\nBeware of fatigue!

TRAINER_CARTER.name: Carter
messages: Wahahah! This dude’s going to catch\nhimself a big one!{be01}
This dude just lost one…
This dude thinks you’re a big one.\nNo, you’re a big-one-to-be!

TRAINER_CATHERINE_1.name: Catherine
messages: Oh? Look at you.{be01}\nFor someone on an adventure,\nyou’re traveling awfully light.{be01}
Accidents happen when you’re not\nprepared!

You’re traveling light but you have
everything you need.{be01}
You’re on top of things mentally and
physically, too.

TRAINER_CEDRIC.name: Cedric
messages: Have you lost your bearings?\nHave no fear for I am here!{be01}
Weren’t you lost?
I had this feeling that a lost Trainer\nwould be panicked and easy to beat.{be01}\nIt’s dirty and I won’t try it again…

TRAINER_CELIA.name: Celia
messages: I shouldn’t have come to a place like\nthis for a picnic!{be01}
Aww!\nI really shouldn’t have come!
In a sandstorm like this, I can’t set\nthe places for a picnic even with my{be00}\nGo-Goggles on…

TRAINER_CELINA.name: Celina
messages: Show me how to put a little excitement\ninto my life.{be01}
Oh… My…\nThat was too much excitement.
My pulse is still racing.\nYou’re one fabulous Trainer.

TRAINER_CHAD.name: Chad
messages: Fufufufu… I dive deep underwater\nto go deep under cover.{be00}\nPlumbing the depths is where I excel!{be01}
Glub, glub, glub…\nI’m sinking…

I have it on good authority that
there’s a Dive spot around here.{be01}
It gives me the urge to go deep
again…

TRAINER_CHANDLER.name: Chandler
messages: Tadaah! See?\nMy inner tube’s round!{be01}
Oh, oh!\nToo bad!
After I showed you my round inner\ntube, too…

TRAINER_CHARLIE.name: Charlie
messages: What’s so funny about having my inner\ntube aboard the ship?{be01}
Whoa, you overwhelmed me!
It’s not easy throwing Poké Balls\nwhile hanging on to an inner tube!

TRAINER_CHARLOTTE.name: Charlotte
messages: Me!\nI’m not just a pretty face!{be01}
That wasn’t cute in the least!

I don’t want a Pokémon that’s
just cute.{be01}
I adore cute ones that have a quirk
or two!

TRAINER_CHASE.name: Chase
messages: This is my first triathlon.\nI’m all tense and nervous!{be01}
Wroooaaar!\nI failed to win!
If I’m all tensed up, I won’t be able to\ngive it my all.

TRAINER_CHESTER.name: Chester
messages: Take flight!\nMy Bird Pokémon!{be01}
They did take flight…
If they’d get stronger, they’d be able\nto fly more freely…

TRAINER_CHIP.name: Chip
messages: What a disgraceful setback…
That giant rock… I would like to\nbelieve it may indeed contain ancient{be00}\nruins. But I see no entrance.

TRAINER_CHRIS.name: Chris
messages: I don’t have a clue about what it\ntakes to win.
Go for a Surf on my Pokémon…{be01}\nThen fish off its back…{be01}\nIt’s an indescribably luxuriant moment!

TRAINER_CINDY_1.name: Cindy
messages: We must have been fated to meet.\nMay I ask you for a battle?{be01}
Oh, my!
“Hello” is the beginning of “good-bye.”\nI hope we meet again.

TRAINER_CINDY_3.name: Presley
messages: Why would a Birdkeeper like me\ncome out to the sea?{be01}
Okay.\nI’ll tell you why I’m here.

I put a message in a bottle and put
it out to sea.{be01}
I’m sure that a girl Swimmer will
find it!

TRAINER_CINDY_4.name: Dianne
messages: The elite among the elite gather in\nthis cave.{be01}\nHow are you finding it?{be01}
Not rattled in the least bit!
You do have guts! I like that!\nKeep it going!

TRAINER_CINDY_5.name: Jani
messages: I’m not good at swimming,\nbut I am good at battles!{be01}
Oops.\nThat didn’t go very well.
Walking around barefoot in this ship\nis kind of gross.

TRAINER_CINDY_6.name: Sienna
messages: I’m throwing my whole heart\ninto this!{be01}
You had more heart!
I need to cool down now…\nI think I’ll go for a dive.

TRAINER_CLARENCE.name: Clarence
messages: Surfing isn’t as easy as it seems,\nisn’t that right?{be01}
Winning sure isn’t easy.
You have your sights on the Pokémon\nLeague? Keep at it!

TRAINER_CLARISSA.name: Clarissa
messages: Why am I carrying this parasol?{be01}\nI’ll tell you if you can win against me.{be01}
A parasol can’t ward off Pokémon\nattacks…
I don’t think strong sunlight is good\nfor my Pokémon.{be00}\nSo I shield them with my parasol.

TRAINER_CLARK.name: Clark
messages: If the tunnel doesn’t go through, then\nI’ll just go over the top.{be01}
Gasp… Gasp…\nLosing made me tired…
It’s no big deal if there’s no tunnel.\nTo a Hiker, mountains are roads!

TRAINER_CLAUDE.name: Claude
messages: If we were fishing, you wouldn’t stand\na chance against me.{be00}\nSo, bring on your Pokémon!{be01}
If we were fishing, I would’ve won…

I think I’ll try my luck at landing
a big one at Meteor Falls.{be01}
There has to be something in there.
I just know it.

TRAINER_CLIFF.name: Beau
messages: Wearing these Go-Goggles makes me\nfeel like a superhero.{be00}\nRight now, nobody can beat me!{be01}
I can’t win on spirit alone…
I’m going to be a real hero one day.\nI’m going to work harder to make me{be00}\nand my Pokémon stronger.

TRAINER_CLIFFORD.name: Clifford
messages: I may be past my prime, but I suggest\nyou not patronize me.{be01}
Ah, you overflow with the power\nof youth!
It seems that I could not overcome\nyour youthful energy.

TRAINER_CLYDE.name: Braxton
messages: Oh, you’re worthy, all right!
You did your Badges proud in that\nmatch!

TRAINER_COBY.name: Coby
messages: Pfft, with these wings I can\nflick you away!{be01}
A… What?
I don’t know what to say when I get\nbeaten so easily…

TRAINER_CODY.name: Nolen
messages: I heard you approaching, so I hung\naround for you!{be01}
I surrender!
Sound travels faster in water than\nit does through air.

TRAINER_COLE.name: Cole
messages: Owowowowow!\nYikes, it’s hot!{be01}
I’m blinded by sweat in my eyes…

Being buried in hot sand promotes
circulation.{be01}
It’s effective for healing pain in
your joints.

TRAINER_COLIN.name: Colin
messages: Do you have any moves that can strike\na flying Pokémon?{be01}
You soared above me!

The move Fly is convenient,
don’t you think?{be01}
While the Pokémon is flying,
almost no moves can strike it.

TRAINER_COLTON.name: Colton
messages: I often sail to Lilycove City.{be01}\nI enjoy attending Contests,\nyou see.{be01}
That was an enjoyable match!
I get so excited imagining what kinds\nof Pokémon I’ll get to see in the next{be00}\nContest. The anticipation of it thrills!

TRAINER_CONNIE.name: Connie
messages: I should teach you how harsh battles\ncan be.{be01}
Oh.\nYou’re strong.
I’ll tell you something good.{be01}\nIf you want to reach Juan, you\nneed to walk on each floor tile once.

TRAINER_CONNOR.name: Donny
messages: Do you have a rival whom you just\nhate to lose against?{be01}
Arrrgh!\nI hate losing!
If you have a rival, don’t you get the\nfeeling that you have to keep getting{be00}\nbetter?

TRAINER_CONOR.name: Conor
messages: Young people are too happy to go with\nthe flow. They’re without direction.{be01}
You have a firm sense of purpose.
Don’t let others lead you astray.\nDon’t lose direction as you grow older.

TRAINER_CORA.name: Cora
messages: It’s too much bother to think this out.\nI only wanted to battle!{be01}
Even though I lost, I still like battling\nthe best!
Wouldn’t you agree? You would go\nanywhere if Trainers were there.

TRAINER_CORY_1.name: Cory
messages: I love Water-type Pokémon.\nI love other Pokémon, too!{be01}
Waaah! I lost!\nWaaah! Waaah!
Shouting is good for me!\nIt uplifts me!

TRAINER_CRISSY.name: Crissy
messages: You came all the way here, but you won’t\nget to see Juan.{be01}\nNot if you lose to me, you won’t!{be01}
You’re strong!\nI was fooled by your cute looks!
You might be good enough to avoid\nbeing wiped out in one hit by Juan.

TRAINER_CRISTIAN.name: Cristian
messages: If you mean to pass, it has to be\nthrough me!{be01}
Grrrrr!\nVastly overpowered!
You win!\nGo after that Badge!

TRAINER_CRISTIN_1.name: Cristin
messages: I have this routine.\nDefeat five Trainers a day.{be00}\nGuess what? You’re number five!{be01}
No!\nYou’re horrid!
I didn’t expect to lose this easily…\nI’ll win next time!

TRAINER_CYNDY_1.name: Cyndy
messages: This beach is my secret training spot!\nDon’t come butting in!{be01}
I haven’t trained enough!
The sand acts as a cushion to reduce\nimpact and prevent injury.{be00}\nThis is the perfect place to train.

TRAINER_CYNDY_2.name: Rachel
messages: Wherever and whenever I may be,\nI always have my parasol in hand.{be01}
Oh, but…\nThat’s not fair.
You’re asking if my parasol is heavy?\nYour Bag is filled with more junk than{be00}\nI ever carry around.

TRAINER_CYNDY_3.name: Leonel
messages: Your party Pokémon…\nDo you have different types?{be01}
I’ve seen your policy in action!
I think it’s awesome you’re so strong\nbattling with your favorite Pokémon.

TRAINER_CYNDY_4.name: Callie
messages: If you don’t pay attention,\nyou could get hurt!{be01}
Ouch!\nI was the one to get hurt.
I wonder… Should I evolve my Pokémon?\nThey’re cute the way they are, though.

TRAINER_CYNDY_5.name: Cale
messages: Of course I lost!\nI’m holding stuff in both hands!

I bought too much stuff at
the Lilycove Dept. Store.{be01}
It’s up the road from here.
I wish I had a Bag like yours.

TRAINER_DAISUKE.name: Daisuke
messages: To train myself, I challenge all\nwhom I meet!{be01}
Uncle! I give up!
All I can do is keep training until\nI can defeat strong Trainers such{be00}\nas yourself.

TRAINER_DAISY.name: Daisy
messages: Did you feel the tug of our\nsoul-soothing fragrance?{be01}
You weren’t led astray by our aroma…
Aromatherapy is a form of mental\nhealing that works with fragrances.

TRAINER_DALE.name: Dale
messages: Hey!\nDon’t sneak up behind me like that!{be01}
I lost!\nDrat!
Fishing is all about concentration.\nYou have to focus on the floater.

TRAINER_DALTON_1.name: Dalton
messages: Let my melody rock your soul!{be01}
La-lalala…

An electric guitar doesn’t always
have to be noisy…{be01}
It can be strummed to squeeze out
this heart-stirring melody…

TRAINER_DALTON_2.name: Grunt
messages: If you want to join Team Aqua that\nbadly, we can consider it…
We have a great combination going\nwith us members and our leader.

TRAINER_DALTON_3.name: Grunt
messages: Urrrgh…{be01}\nI should’ve ducked into our Hideout\nright away…

TRAINER_DALTON_4.name: Marc
messages: Oh, man oh man!\nOur challenger is one feisty customer!
I have to hand it to our Leader.{be01}\nIt took smarts and sense for her to\npick the Rock type at her young age.

TRAINER_DALTON_5.name: Brenden
messages: I’ll show you the gumption of\na sailing man!{be01}
How’d this happen?\nIt’s not like me to lose this way!
Oh, aye! You’re worthy of seeing\nour Gym Leader.

TRAINER_DANA.name: Dana
messages: I try not to swim where the currents\nare too strong.{be01}
Oh, please, no!
If I get swept away, I’ll lose all my\nsense of place…

TRAINER_DANIELLE.name: Danielle
messages: Um…\nOkay, I’ll battle with you.{be01}
Oh, but you’re too strong.
I’m going to be a pretty and strong\nTrainer just like Flannery.

TRAINER_DAPHNE.name: Daphne
messages: You battled with more beauty than\nI could muster…

The grace you bring to battle is
fabulous.{be01}
Oh… I’m so fortunate to have found
Pokémon.

TRAINER_DARCY.name: Darcy
messages: I liked training here by myself.\nIt’s awful that all these people came!{be01}
Okay! I won’t complain about other\npeople being here.
I suppose I can partner up with that\nold man and challenge that other team.

TRAINER_DARIAN.name: Darian
messages: I fished up a tough-looking Pokémon!{be01}\nIt has this magical quality to it!\nIt surely looks tough, yes it does!{be01}
What the…
Hey, Magikarp, you sure don’t live up\nto your name, do you?

TRAINER_DARIUS.name: Darius
messages: You’d better know that there are all\nsorts of Flying-type Pokémon.{be01}\nYou do know that, right?{be01}
You seem to know your stuff!
Sure, you beat me all right.\nBut you’d better watch it! Our Leader{be00}\nWinona’s Pokémon are all business.

TRAINER_DARRIN.name: Darrin
messages: Yawn…{be01}\nI must have drifted off to sleep while\nI was drifting in the waves.{be01}
Ahaha, I lost…\nI’ll take a snooze, I think…
Floating and being rocked by\nthe waves--it’s like sleeping in{be00}\na plush, comfy bed.

TRAINER_DAVID.name: David
messages: Hiyah! Look at my chiseled abs!\nThis is what you call “cut”!{be01}
Aiyah!\nFlubbed out!
Hiyah!{be01}\nMy sculpted abs have nothing to do\nwith Pokémon battles!

TRAINER_DAVIS.name: Davis
messages: This is my awesome Bug Pokémon!\nMy big brother got it for me.{be01}
Waaaah!\nYou meanie!
Don’t tell my brother I lost.\nYou have to keep it a secret!

TRAINER_DAWN.name: Imani
messages: The blue, blue sky…\nThe vast sea…{be00}\nIt’s so peaceful…{be01}
I lost while I was lounging!
I want to be told I’m relaxing to be\nwith. Giggle.

TRAINER_DAWSON.name: Dawson
messages: When you lay your eyes on my Pokémon’s\ngorgeous fur, their beauty will render{be00}\nyou helpless!{be01}
Oh, baby, say it isn’t so!

TRAINER_DAYTON.name: Dayton
messages: Hohoho!\nI like kid Trainers!{be00}\nLet’s have a good one!{be01}
You’re pretty amazing!\nHohoho!
Hohoho!\nI’ll try emulating the pep of kid{be00}\nTrainers like you!

TRAINER_DEAN.name: Dean
messages: This towering white mountain of rock\nis Sootopolis City.{be01}
I was done in?
I can’t find the entrance to\nSootopolis. Where could it be?

TRAINER_DEANDRE.name: Deandre
messages: Go, go, go!\nPokémon 1, 2, and 3!{be01}
Come in, Pokémon! Are you okay?\nPokémon 1, 2, and 3?!
Isn’t it cool that I have a Pokémon\nbattle team?{be01}\nYou can copy me--I don’t mind!

TRAINER_DEBRA.name: Debra
messages: I’ve led a life of woe and misery…\nI’ve been cast away, and this is where{be00}\nI’ve drifted…{be01}
Another loss…
A life adrift…\nI don’t want it anymore!

TRAINER_DECLAN.name: Declan
messages: I’m feeling blue.\nBlue as the sky…
I should chat up lady Swimmers\nand invite them on a long swim.

TRAINER_DEMETRIUS.name: Demetrius
messages: Waaah!\nI’ve been found! …Huh?{be01}
Oh, you’re not my mom.
I’m in trouble with my mom, so I ran.\nKeep it a secret where I am!

TRAINER_DENISE.name: Denise
messages: Do you know a little town called\nDewford?{be01}
I hate this!
A weird saying is getting really\ntrendy at Dewford Hall.

TRAINER_DEREK.name: Derek
messages: My ineptitude also remains\nunchanged…

TRAINER_DEVAN.name: Devan
messages: We’ll rock you hard!{be01}
Aiyiyi!\nNo contest at all!
I should try different Pokémon\ntypes, that’s what I ought to do.

TRAINER_DEZ_AND_LUKE.name: Dez & Luke
messages: Luke: Whoopsie!{be01}\nDez: Waaaah! I’m scared!
Luke: Well, we lost but that’s okay!\nI’m right here by your side.{be00}\nWe’ll make it through this dare!

Luke: If you want to take me on,
bring some more Pokémon.{be01}
If you don’t, I won’t be able to show
off to my girl how cool I am!
Dez: We’re lovey-dovey, so we don’t\ncare if we lose!

Dez: If you want to challenge us, you
should bring at least two Pokémon.{be01}
My boyfriend’s strong.
Just one Pokémon won’t do at all.

TRAINER_DIANA_1.name: Diana
messages: This place isn’t your casual hike.\nIt’s not suited for a picnic.{be01}
Ohhh, no!\nThe ground is too bumpy…
Did you know?{be01}\nSome people cleverly ride their\nbicycles up this horribly bumpy pass.

TRAINER_DIANA_2.name: Mariela
messages: Nufufufu, here at last!\nLet’s get right with it!{be01}
You’re so casual about winning!
Humph! I’m not upset!\nNot me!

TRAINER_DIANA_3.name: Alvaro
messages: I ever so closely watched you coming!{be01}
This outcome I didn’t see coming…

Well, anyway, we both picked a weird
place to get acquainted.{be01}
As one weirdo to another,
let’s do our best!

TRAINER_DIANA_4.name: Everett
messages: It’s awfully cramped in here…{be01}
Oh, yes, strong you are.
I was hoping to switch places with you\nwhen I beat you, but…

TRAINER_DIANNE.name: Dianne
messages: The elite among the elite gather in\nthis cave.{be01}\nHow are you finding it?{be01}
Not rattled in the least bit!
You do have guts! I like that!\nKeep it going!

TRAINER_DILLON.name: Dillon
messages: The volcano’s eruption is proof that\nthe earth is alive.{be01}
You’re some kind of strong!

TRAINER_DOMINIK.name: Dominik
messages: Swimming the deep blue sea…\nIt feels the greatest!{be01}
I lost…\nNow I’m feeling blue…
Why is the sea blue?{be01}\nI learned about that at the Museum in\nSlateport, but I forgot.

TRAINER_DONALD.name: Donald
messages: So, we finally meet!\nMy Bug Pokémon will keep you company!{be01}
I wish we’d never met…
I want to Mimic you some more.\nCan you hurry up and move?

TRAINER_DONNY.name: Donny
messages: Do you have a rival whom you just\nhate to lose against?{be01}
Arrrgh!\nI hate losing!
If you have a rival, don’t you get the\nfeeling that you have to keep getting{be00}\nbetter?

TRAINER_DOUG.name: Doug
messages: Yep, you’ve finally caught me!\nOr were you trying to avoid me?{be01}
Whoop, that was a great match!
We’re the Mimic Circle!\nI hope you enjoyed our performance.

TRAINER_DOUGLAS.name: Douglas
messages: Hahahah! I’m a lousy runner, but in\nthe water you can’t catch me!{be01}
I give up!
I wouldn’t lose in a swim race…

TRAINER_DRAKE.name: Drake
messages: Superb, it should be said.

TRAINER_DREW.name: Drew
messages: I couldn’t see what was happening at\nmy sides because of the Go-Goggles.
The Go-Goggles make it possible to\nget through sandstorms.{be00}\nThat makes me happy!

TRAINER_DUNCAN.name: Duncan
messages: When we go out to sea, we Sailors\nalways bring our Pokémon.{be00}\nHow about a quick battle?{be01}
Whoops, I’m sunk!

The ship’s bottom has sunk into the
depths.{be01}
If a Pokémon knew how to go underwater,
we might make some progress…

TRAINER_DUSTY_1.name: Dusty
messages: For thirty years I have searched for\nancient ruins!{be00}\nI am to be challenged?{be01}
While I have searched for ruins,\nI’ve not searched for strong Pokémon.

For thirty years I have searched for
ancient ruins!{be01}
No, wait, was that forty years?
Which was it now?

TRAINER_DUSTY_2.name: Ed
messages: When there are no Trainers around,\nI let my Pokémon battle each other.{be00}\nI watch them.{be01}
I kind of like your Pokémon.
Hehe, I’m swiping your battling ideas!\nI think they’ll make me better.

TRAINER_DUSTY_3.name: Declan
messages: I’m feeling blue.\nBlue as the sky…
I should chat up lady Swimmers\nand invite them on a long swim.

TRAINER_DUSTY_4.name: Grunt
messages: We gave you fair warning!\nThere’s nothing sneaky about us!{be01}
Grrr…\nWe should’ve used sneaky treachery…
Okay, I get it already! The next time,\nwe’ll come unannounced.

TRAINER_DUSTY_5.name: Fredrick
messages: Hello, child!\nCan you spare some time?{be01}
Ah, a mighty capable child!\nLet me contribute to your allowance.
Contribute to your allowance?\nWasn’t the prize money enough?

TRAINER_DWAYNE.name: Dwayne
messages: If you’re looking for a battle in the\nSeashore House, you’ll find no{be00}\nhotter Trainer than me, matey!{be01}
That was a hot battle!\nI can accept that loss, matey!
Whenever I’m in Slateport, I enjoy\nhot battles and ice-cold Soda Pop!

TRAINER_DYLAN_1.name: Dylan
messages: I’m in the middle of a triathlon, but,\nwhatever, let’s have a battle!{be01}
I ran out of energy!
I may have blown it…{be01}\nI might have dropped to last during\nthat battle…

TRAINER_DYLAN_2.name: Darcy
messages: I liked training here by myself.\nIt’s awful that all these people came!{be01}
Okay! I won’t complain about other\npeople being here.
I suppose I can partner up with that\nold man and challenge that other team.

TRAINER_DYLAN_3.name: Maxie
messages: All I want…\nI just want to expand the land mass…

TRAINER_DYLAN_4.name: Pete
messages: This sort of distance…\nYou should just swim it!{be01}
Oh, that’s good going!

Oh, I understand where you’re coming
from now.{be01}
If I had a Pokémon that trusty,
I’d want to Surf on it, too!

TRAINER_DYLAN_5.name: Isabelle
messages: Watch where you’re going!\nWe’re going to crash!{be01}
Groan…
I’m a poor swimmer so I was practicing…\nSorry for almost crashing into you.

TRAINER_ED.name: Ed
messages: When there are no Trainers around,\nI let my Pokémon battle each other.{be00}\nI watch them.{be01}
I kind of like your Pokémon.
Hehe, I’m swiping your battling ideas!\nI think they’ll make me better.

TRAINER_EDDIE.name: Eddie
messages: I wandered into this weird house\nby accident…{be01}
And now I’ve lost…
I lost my way, I lost a battle, and I’m\nnow even more lost… I can’t get out…

TRAINER_EDGAR.name: Edgar
messages: I’ve made it this far a couple times,\nbut the last stretch is so long…{be01}
My dream ends here again…
You’ve made it this far. Keep the\nmomentum going and become the{be00}\nChampion! If anyone can, it’s you!

TRAINER_EDMOND.name: Edmond
messages: Urrrrppp…\nBattle? With me?{be01}
Urp… Ooooooohhhhhh…\nUrrrrpppp…
I’m usually stronger than this!\nI’m just seasick as a dog!{be01}\nI’m a Sailor, but…

TRAINER_EDWARD.name: Edward
messages: I have foreseen your intentions!\nI cannot possibly lose!{be01}
I failed to prophesize my own demise!
I see your future…{be01}\nHmm…\nI see a shining light…

TRAINER_EDWARDO.name: Edwardo
messages: It was too much of a load for me\nto bear…

The world is huge, and there are
countless tough Trainers.{be01}
I’m going to keep training and make
myself even stronger.

TRAINER_EDWIN_1.name: Edwin
messages: Could I see your Pokémon?\nJust one look, please?{be01}
I wanted to complete\nmy collection…
When I see a Pokémon that I don’t know,\nmy passion as a collector is ignited!

TRAINER_ELAINE.name: Keira
messages: Consider yourself lucky to be\nbattling me!{be01}
This isn’t right!\nI can’t lose!
It’s a miracle that you beat me.\nYou can brag about it.

TRAINER_ELI.name: Eli
messages: As much as I love mountains,\nI especially love volcanoes.{be01}
Well, it seems to me I lost without\never being in control.
I stay here because I became a fan\nof Flannery’s power.{be01}\nHehehehe.

TRAINER_ELIJAH.name: Elijah
messages: For a guy as macho as me, this kind\nof Pokémon is the perfect match!{be01}
I’m cool even in defeat, hey?
For a guy as macho as me, a port\nis the perfect setting!{be01}\nI guess I’ll head for Slateport.

TRAINER_ELLIOT_1.name: Elliot
messages: Which do you prefer, fishing in the\nsea or a stream?{be01}
Like in deep-sea fishing, I lost\nspectacularly!
Fishing is the greatest whether it’s\nin the sea or a stream.{be00}\nYou agree with me, right?

TRAINER_ELLIOT_2.name: Grunt
messages: I can’t stand heat. Maybe I should’ve\njoined Team Aqua instead…{be01}
Yeah, I really may not be right for\nTeam Magma…
Don’t you get lonely for the sea\nbeing in a place like this?

TRAINER_ELLIOT_3.name: Grunt
messages: You’re a fiery battler.\nJust like a volcano!

You just happened to win this time,
but that doesn’t matter.{be01}
Team Magma’s goal is about to be
reached!

TRAINER_ELLIOT_4.name: Grunt
messages: I’m having trouble believing this…
I’m getting this feeling that our plan\nis going to end in failure…

TRAINER_ELLIOT_5.name: Grunt
messages: What did I do to deserve this guard\nposting?{be01}\nMy left ear is burning up!{be01}
I’m getting heat exhaustion…
Do you think it’s odd that we’re wearing\nhoods in this magma-filled volcano?

TRAINER_ERIC.name: Eric
messages: Losing left me bitter!
Yes, I did lose at Pokémon…{be01}\nBut, when it comes to the love of\nthe mountains, I have you beat!

TRAINER_ERNEST_1.name: Ernest
messages: Ahoy! I’m a buff, tough Sailor!\nI’ve braved the world’s seas!{be01}
Gwrroooar!\nI couldn’t win!

The tide ebbs and flows inside the
Shoal Cave.{be01}
By the way, it’s about six hours from
high tide to low tide. Did you know?

TRAINER_ETHAN_1.name: Ethan
messages: Jagged Pass is hard to walk on.\nIt’s a good place for training.{be01}
It was all over while we were still\ntrying to find a good footing…
If I had an Acro Bike, I’d be able to\njump ledges.

TRAINER_ETHAN_2.name: Athena
messages: We should have a slow and methodical\nmatch.{be01}
You didn’t give me the chance to\ndo any strategizing.
When I’m surrounded by the blue sea\nand sky, it feels as if time slows down.

TRAINER_ETHAN_3.name: Harrison
messages: You’re looking awfully tough.\nI wonder if I can win?{be01}
Ouch!\nI guess it was impossible to win.

There are tough Trainers galore
around Ever Grande.{be01}
Do you think I may be out
of my league?

TRAINER_ETHAN_4.name: Grunt
messages: Hunh?\nWhat do you mean I lost?

Our Boss says, “It will make everyone
happy.”{be01}
But why does everyone keep getting
in our way?

TRAINER_ETHAN_5.name: Clarence
messages: Surfing isn’t as easy as it seems,\nisn’t that right?{be01}
Winning sure isn’t easy.
You have your sights on the Pokémon\nLeague? Keep at it!

TRAINER_EUGENE.name: Chris
messages: I don’t have a clue about what it\ntakes to win.
Go for a Surf on my Pokémon…{be01}\nThen fish off its back…{be01}\nIt’s an indescribably luxuriant moment!

TRAINER_EVERETT.name: Everett
messages: It’s awfully cramped in here…{be01}
Oh, yes, strong you are.
I was hoping to switch places with you\nwhen I beat you, but…

TRAINER_FABIAN.name: Fabian
messages: Hit me with a power chord!\nVictory is mine!{be00}\nIt’s our time to shine, whoa, yeah!{be01}
You showed me who’s the boss!\nWe’ll have to take the loss, oh, no!
Hit me with another power chord!\nLeave me alone!{be00}\nYour win you have to atone!

TRAINER_FELIX.name: Felix
messages: I’ve come this far, but the tension’s\ngiving me awful stomach pain…{be01}
Ooh…\nIt hurts…
I can’t help getting all tense knowing\nthat I’m nearing the Pokémon League.{be01}\nIt’s all I can do to feign calm.

TRAINER_FERNANDO_1.name: Fernando
messages: I’ll turn your lights out while\nI rip through this tune!{be01}
Hey, hold it!\nI was still playing the intro!
You’re rock steady.\nI’d like to write a tune about you.

TRAINER_FLANNERY.name: Flannery
messages: Your power reminds me of someone…{be01}\nOh! I know! You battle like Norman,\nthe Gym Leader of Petalburg.

TRAINER_FLANNERY_1.name: Flannery
messages: Your power reminds me of someone…{be01}\nOh! I know! You battle like Norman,\nthe Gym Leader of Petalburg.

TRAINER_FLINT.name: Flint
messages: There’s no need for Winona, our Gym\nLeader, to deal with you!{be01}\nI’m plenty good enough for you!{be01}
Winona, I…\nI lost!
Winona is cute and she’s strong.\nShe’s the ultimate Leader!{be01}\nBlush…

TRAINER_FOSTER.name: Foster
messages: There’s supposed to be a mystical\nrock around here.{be00}\nDo you know anything about it?{be01}
I was thinking too much about that\nrock, while my Pokémon remained weak…
I can spend hours and hours staring\nat a nice rock without growing bored.

TRAINER_FRANKLIN.name: Franklin
messages: Did the currents carry you here, too?\nThis must have been fated.{be00}\nLet’s battle!{be01}
Strong!\nToo much so!
It’s just my luck that a tough Trainer\nlike you would drift here…{be00}\nI must be cursed…

TRAINER_FREDRICK.name: Fredrick
messages: Hello, child!\nCan you spare some time?{be01}
Ah, a mighty capable child!\nLet me contribute to your allowance.
Contribute to your allowance?\nWasn’t the prize money enough?

TRAINER_FRITZ.name: Blake
messages: My Pokémon battling skills are out\nof sync, too!

Gabby: We’ll be keeping an eye out\nfor you!

Gabby: Is there a strong Trainer\nanywhere with a lot of Pokémon?

TRAINER_GABRIELLE_1.name: Gabrielle
messages: Why have you come here?{be01}
That was amazing!\nYou’re a very special Trainer.

TRAINER_GARRET.name: Garret
messages: Ah, you’ve come just in time.{be01}\nI’m bored, you see.\nYou may entertain me.{be01}
…That will do.
Perhaps I shall get Father to acquire\na yacht for me.{be00}\nA yacht for me and Pokémon!

TRAINER_GARRISON.name: Garrison
messages: Strength and compassion…\nThose are a Trainer’s treasures!{be01}
Ah, there is something about you\nthat sparkles.
In a cabin somewhere on board,\nI saw something sparkle.

TRAINER_GEORGE.name: George
messages: I couldn’t restore HP enough…\nWhat Attack power…

TRAINER_GEORGIA.name: Georgia
messages: I want to make my own Gym one day.\nSo, I’m studying how to set traps.{be01}
I didn’t study battling enough!
You’re strong, aren’t you?\nMaybe even enough to be a Gym Leader!

TRAINER_GERALD.name: Gerald
messages: Can your Pokémon withstand\n392-degree heat?{be01}
It didn’t burn hotly enough…

The temperature of magma is
392 degrees.{be01}
Your Pokémon beat me, so they should
easily survive in magma.

TRAINER_GILBERT.name: Gilbert
messages: I used to catch colds all the time as\na kid, but I became totally fit after{be00}\nI started swimming.{be01}
I crave more power…
Trainers travel the fields and\nmountains, so they must be fit, too.

TRAINER_GINA_AND_MIA_1.name: Gina & Mia
messages: Gina: Okay, let’s battle with our\nPokémon!{be01}
Gina: Losing upsets me!{be01}\nMia: We battled together, but we\nboth lost…
Gina: You are strong!\nWe have to train lots more!

Gina: Oh? Only one Pokémon?
Then, we don’t battle with you.{be01}
If there’s only one Pokémon, it will
be lonesome. That’s not nice.
Mia: We are twins, so we battle\nPokémon together.{be01}
Mia: We will train our Pokémon more\nand be strong like you.

TRAINER_GLACIA.name: Glacia

TRAINER_GRACE.name: Grace
messages: I’m growing bored of swimming…\nHow about a battle?{be01}
I had no idea that you were\nthis strong!
All the effort you put in must have\nmade you this strong.

TRAINER_GREG.name: Greg
messages: You don’t know who I am, do you?{be01}\nBut, I also don’t know you.\nSo, we’ll battle!{be01}
You’re pretty strong!
Until you go away somewhere, we’ll\nkeep on mimicking your every move.

TRAINER_GRUNT_1.name: Grunt
messages: Ayiyiyi!\nSuspicious character spotted!{be01}
Grrrrr…\nI lost it!
I took the loss for the Team,\nbut I did my job…

TRAINER_GRUNT_13.name: Grunt
messages: Who are you?\nWhere do you think you’re going?{be01}
I failed to win!
My partner forgot the map in that\nsubmarine!{be01}\nHow’s that for being useless?

TRAINER_GRUNT_15.name: Grunt
messages: Urrrggh! My career in crime comes to\na dead end!

TRAINER_GRUNT_16.name: Grunt
messages: Blast it…\nBlasted by a kid…
Our Boss knows everything.{be01}\nBut I’m just a Grunt. What would I know\nabout what he’s thinking?

TRAINER_GRUNT_17.name: Grunt
messages: The Institute created a type of\nPokémon that has something to do with{be00}\nthe weather. We’re here to take them!{be01}
Our plan’s being spoiled by a kid?
If the Pokémon they made here can\ncontrol the weather freely, then we of{be00}\nTeam Aqua definitely need it!

TRAINER_GRUNT_18.name: Grunt
messages: We’re Team Aqua!\nWe appear wherever anything rare is{be00}\nfound!{be01}
You got me!
You don’t have any idea what we of\nTeam Aqua are working towards!{be00}\nYou stay out of our way!

TRAINER_GRUNT_19.name: Grunt
messages: Awaaaah!\nA kid beat me!
Oh, man, what a disaster…\nThe Boss is going to be furious…

TRAINER_GRUNT_2.name: Grunt
messages: If you want to know the secret about\nour Hideout, you have me to beat!{be01}
I can’t win at all…

TRAINER_GRUNT_20.name: Grunt
messages: What?!\nI lost, too!

Now what? If we don’t get the parts,
we’re in for it!{be01}
Arrgh, I didn’t count on being meddled
with by some meddling kid!

TRAINER_GRUNT_22.name: Grunt
messages: No! Those Team Magma goons got\nhere ahead of us!{be01}\nWe can’t fall behind!{be01}
I thought you were one of the Magmas\nwho happened to come back…
Yeah, so you are strong…\nBut there’re a lot of us!

TRAINER_GRUNT_23.name: Grunt
messages: Urgh… I should’ve let you take on\nTeam Magma first…
You don’t know anything!\nSo why are you messing with us?

TRAINER_GRUNT_24.name: Grunt
messages: If you’re going to mess with anyone,\nlet it be Team Magma…

Heh, it doesn’t matter!
We bought ourselves some time!{be01}
The Boss should have snatched what
he was after!

TRAINER_GRUNT_25.name: Grunt
messages: Huh?\nWhat’s a kid doing here?{be01}
Huh?\nI lost?!
Oh, no…\nI’ll catch an earful for losing to a kid…{be01}\nI should just take a nap in the bed…

TRAINER_GRUNT_26.name: Grunt
messages: Yawn… Keeping watch over the\nHideout bores me. I’ll take you on.{be01}
Yawn…\nOh, I lost…
If you scurry too much, other Team\nAqua members might get you.

TRAINER_GRUNT_27.name: Grunt
messages: What’s wrong with you?\nYou’re not tired at all!

That reminds me… I can’t remember
where I put the Master Ball.{be01}
If I fail to guard it, our Boss will
chew me out…

TRAINER_GRUNT_3.name: Grunt
messages: I took a serious licking!
Humph!\nThis was supposed to happen!{be01}\nMy mission was to just hold you up!

TRAINER_GRUNT_4.name: Grunt
messages: Wahahah, I grew weary of waiting!\nYou owe me a battle, too!{be01}
Tired of waiting…\nLost and dazed…
Boss…\nIs this good enough?

TRAINER_GRUNT_5.name: Grunt
messages: We don’t need a kid around!\nGo on home already!{be01}
I want to go home…
I want to get a promotion so I can\nboss around the Grunts…

TRAINER_GRUNT_6.name: Grunt
messages: That submarine… It’s tiny inside.\nI’m sore all over!{be01}
Losing makes me sore!
That submarine we jacked, man,\nit’s brutal as a ride.{be00}\nIt’s way too tight in there!

TRAINER_GRUNT_7.name: Grunt
messages: Who are you?\nWhere did you come in from?{be01}
Lost it…
I can’t find the way out!{be01}\nI’m not afraid. Don’t get me wrong!

TRAINER_GRUNT_9.name: Grunt
messages: You’re kidding me! You’re tough!

If I fail to guard it, our Boss will
chew me out…

TRAINER_GRUNT_AQUA_HIDEOUT_7.name: Grunt
messages: I lost in a cool way…
If you have a cool uniform, you look\ngood even in a loss, don’t you think?

TRAINER_GRUNT_AQUA_HIDEOUT_8.name: Grunt
messages: When I joined Team Aqua, the first\nthing I had to learn was how these{be00}\nwarp panels connected.{be01}
I was too occupied thinking about\nthe warp panels…
I’ll have to learn about how I can\nbattle more effectively…

TRAINER_GRUNT_JAGGED_PASS.name: Grunt
messages: Urrrgh…{be01}\nI should’ve ducked into our Hideout\nright away…

TRAINER_GRUNT_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_1.name: Grunt
messages: I’m always late for training sessions,\ntoo!{be01}\nI hate to say it, but I’m wimpy…
Okay, I’ll try to put a little more\neffort into things from now on…

TRAINER_GRUNT_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_10.name: Grunt
messages: Yeah, I think we are doing something\nwrong somehow.
You know, losing to you cleared my mind.{be01}\nThe next time I see our leader,\nI’m going to ask him about what we do.

TRAINER_GRUNT_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_11.name: Grunt
messages: I guess it’s impossible to win if one\ndoesn’t have a calm mind…
I wonder if Groudon even has a tail?

TRAINER_GRUNT_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_12.name: Grunt
messages: Fuhahaha!\nSoon! Very soon!{be00}\nOur grand objective will be achieved!{be01}
Grrr…\nI’ve come so far, but now this?
Maxie, sir!\nAn intruder is headed your way!

TRAINER_GRUNT_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_13.name: Grunt
messages: You’re not finished yet!\nYou’re not getting by me easily!{be01}
Was I that easy to knock down?
C-come on, one more match…

TRAINER_GRUNT_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_14.name: Grunt
messages: Aiyiyi…\nMy pride as a Team Magma member…
If you suffer from chills, you should\njoin Team Magma.

TRAINER_GRUNT_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_15.name: Grunt
messages: I don’t have a bone to pick with you.\nI’m just following orders!{be01}
I may have lost, but…

We dug up something beyond belief!
And, we got the Blue Orb!{be01}
All that’s left is for our leader to…
Fufufu… Fwahahaha!

TRAINER_GRUNT_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_16.name: Grunt
messages: Oh, no!\nYou’re not to be trusted at all!

Listen to me.
Team Magma is right!{be01}
Don’t listen to Team Aqua.
Don’t believe their lies!

TRAINER_GRUNT_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_2.name: Grunt
messages: Arrgh!\nTaken down!

I won’t tell you after all.
You’ll find out when you get there!{be01}
It’d be better if you saved surprises
to the end, don’t you think?

TRAINER_GRUNT_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_3.name: Grunt
messages: Hold it right there!{be01}\nYou don’t really expect me to keep\nmy trap shut and let you waltz by me?{be01}
Ooh wow!\nI concede!
Maybe it would’ve been better if I did\njust let you go unchallenged…

TRAINER_GRUNT_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_4.name: Grunt
messages: Ahah!\nAn intruder!{be01}
Graaah!
I’ve already lost.{be01}\nDo I really need to keep running\naround in a circle?

TRAINER_GRUNT_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_5.name: Grunt
messages: Oh, oh!\nAn intruder!{be01}
Mutter…
Actually, I’m no expert at battling…
