messages: I can’t stand heat. Maybe I should’ve\njoined Team Aqua instead…{be01}
Yeah, I really may not be right for\nTeam Magma…
Don’t you get lonely for the sea\nbeing in a place like this?

TRAINER_GRUNT_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_7.name: Grunt
messages: You’re a fiery battler.\nJust like a volcano!

You just happened to win this time,
but that doesn’t matter.{be01}
Team Magma’s goal is about to be
reached!

TRAINER_GRUNT_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_8.name: Grunt
messages: I’m having trouble believing this…
I’m getting this feeling that our plan\nis going to end in failure…

TRAINER_GRUNT_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_9.name: Grunt
messages: What did I do to deserve this guard\nposting?{be01}\nMy left ear is burning up!{be01}
I’m getting heat exhaustion…
Do you think it’s odd that we’re wearing\nhoods in this magma-filled volcano?

TRAINER_GRUNT_MT_CHIMNEY_1.name: Grunt
messages: If there were more land, I’d be able\nto get a big house of my own!{be01}\nI’m going to build it on hardened lava!{be01}
My dream of a big house…
A kid like you, you ought to be\nsplashing about in the waves!

TRAINER_GRUNT_MT_CHIMNEY_2.name: Grunt
messages: Hunh?\nWhat do you mean I lost?

Our Boss says, “It will make everyone
happy.”{be01}
But why does everyone keep getting
in our way?

TRAINER_GRUNT_MT_PYRE_1.name: Grunt
messages: No! Those Team Magma goons got\nhere ahead of us!{be01}\nWe can’t fall behind!{be01}
I thought you were one of the Magmas\nwho happened to come back…
Yeah, so you are strong…\nBut there’re a lot of us!

TRAINER_GRUNT_MT_PYRE_2.name: Grunt
messages: Urgh… I should’ve let you take on\nTeam Magma first…
You don’t know anything!\nSo why are you messing with us?

TRAINER_GRUNT_MT_PYRE_3.name: Grunt
messages: If you’re going to mess with anyone,\nlet it be Team Magma…

Heh, it doesn’t matter!
We bought ourselves some time!{be01}
The Boss should have snatched what
he was after!

TRAINER_GRUNT_MT_PYRE_4.name: Grunt
messages: If you want to join Team Aqua that\nbadly, we can consider it…
We have a great combination going\nwith us members and our leader.

TRAINER_GRUNT_MUSEUM_1.name: Grunt
messages: Awaaaah!\nA kid beat me!
Oh, man, what a disaster…\nThe Boss is going to be furious…

TRAINER_GRUNT_MUSEUM_2.name: Grunt
messages: What?!\nI lost, too!

Now what? If we don’t get the parts,
we’re in for it!{be01}
Arrgh, I didn’t count on being meddled
with by some meddling kid!

TRAINER_GRUNT_PETALBURG_WOODS.name: Grunt
messages: You’re kidding me! You’re tough!

TRAINER_GRUNT_RUSTURF_TUNNEL.name: Grunt
messages: Urrrggh! My career in crime comes to\na dead end!

TRAINER_GRUNT_SEAFLOOR_CAVERN_1.name: Grunt
messages: We don’t need a kid around!\nGo on home already!{be01}
I want to go home…
I want to get a promotion so I can\nboss around the Grunts…

TRAINER_GRUNT_SEAFLOOR_CAVERN_2.name: Grunt
messages: That submarine… It’s tiny inside.\nI’m sore all over!{be01}
Losing makes me sore!
That submarine we jacked, man,\nit’s brutal as a ride.{be00}\nIt’s way too tight in there!

TRAINER_GRUNT_SEAFLOOR_CAVERN_3.name: Grunt
messages: Who are you?\nWhere did you come in from?{be01}
Lost it…
I can’t find the way out!{be01}\nI’m not afraid. Don’t get me wrong!

TRAINER_GRUNT_SEAFLOOR_CAVERN_4.name: Grunt
messages: Who are you?\nWhere do you think you’re going?{be01}
I failed to win!
My partner forgot the map in that\nsubmarine!{be01}\nHow’s that for being useless?

TRAINER_GRUNT_SEAFLOOR_CAVERN_5.name: Grunt
messages: Gwah!

TRAINER_GRUNT_SPACE_CENTER_1.name: Grunt
messages: We gave you fair warning!\nThere’s nothing sneaky about us!{be01}
Grrr…\nWe should’ve used sneaky treachery…
Okay, I get it already! The next time,\nwe’ll come unannounced.

TRAINER_GRUNT_SPACE_CENTER_2.name: Grunt
messages: Ack! Ack! Aaack!

TRAINER_GRUNT_SPACE_CENTER_3.name: Grunt
messages: As promised, we’ve come for\nthe rocket fuel!{be01}
Ran out of fuel…
Don’t think you’re on a roll just\nbecause you’ve beaten me!

TRAINER_GRUNT_SPACE_CENTER_4.name: Grunt
messages: The rocket fuel the Space Center has\nin storage--that’s what we’re after.{be01}\nWe mean to take every last bit of it!{be01}
Please, can you spare some fuel?\nEven a chintzy cup will do!

What are we going to do with
the rocket fuel?{be01}
How would I know?
Ask our leader upstairs!

TRAINER_GRUNT_SPACE_CENTER_5.name: Grunt
messages: I lost!\nBut!
It’s too soon to be relieved!\nI’m up next!

TRAINER_GRUNT_SPACE_CENTER_6.name: Grunt
messages: I lost, too!\nBut!
I bet you want to take a break.\nBut I’m not about to let you do that!

TRAINER_GRUNT_SPACE_CENTER_7.name: Grunt
messages: We should’ve taken a break…\nThat’s what we should’ve done…

TRAINER_GRUNT_WEATHER_INST_1.name: Grunt
messages: Blast it…\nBlasted by a kid…
Our Boss knows everything.{be01}\nBut I’m just a Grunt. What would I know\nabout what he’s thinking?

TRAINER_GRUNT_WEATHER_INST_2.name: Grunt
messages: The Institute created a type of\nPokémon that has something to do with{be00}\nthe weather. We’re here to take them!{be01}
Our plan’s being spoiled by a kid?
If the Pokémon they made here can\ncontrol the weather freely, then we of{be00}\nTeam Aqua definitely need it!

TRAINER_GRUNT_WEATHER_INST_3.name: Grunt
messages: We’re Team Aqua!\nWe appear wherever anything rare is{be00}\nfound!{be01}
You got me!
You don’t have any idea what we of\nTeam Aqua are working towards!{be00}\nYou stay out of our way!

TRAINER_GRUNT_WEATHER_INST_4.name: Grunt
messages: Huh?\nWhat’s a kid doing here?{be01}
Huh?\nI lost?!
Oh, no…\nI’ll catch an earful for losing to a kid…{be01}\nI should just take a nap in the bed…

TRAINER_GRUNT_WEATHER_INST_5.name: Grunt
messages: Oh, will you look at my Pokémon?

Humph, so what?
What we want…{be01}
What we really want isn’t here…
Ihihihihi…

TRAINER_GWEN.name: Gwen
messages: Hi, big Trainer.\nWill you battle with me?{be01}
Oh, you’re strong.
How did you get to be so strong?

TRAINER_HAILEY.name: Hailey
messages: I can’t swim, so I’m pretending\nto swim.{be01}
I thought so!\nI didn’t think we could win.
When I learn how to swim, I think\nmy Pokémon will become tougher.

TRAINER_HALEY_1.name: Haley
messages: Should I…\nOr shouldn’t I?{be01}\nOkay, sure, I will battle!{be01}
I shouldn’t have battled…

TRAINER_HALLE.name: Halle
messages: Okay, no need to get your back up!\nRelax, let’s take it easy!{be01}
Whoa!\nWonderful!

TRAINER_HANNAH.name: Hannah
messages: You’re just too strong!

I’m not going to get down on myself for
losing. I just need to train harder.{be01}
Positive thinking--that’s my strong
point!

TRAINER_HARRISON.name: Harrison
messages: You’re looking awfully tough.\nI wonder if I can win?{be01}
Ouch!\nI guess it was impossible to win.

There are tough Trainers galore
around Ever Grande.{be01}
Do you think I may be out
of my league?

TRAINER_HAYDEN.name: Hayden
messages: When you’re as famished as I am,\nthere is no room for pity!{be01}
Groan…
My stomach is grumbling!\nMaybe I can grill some Berries…

TRAINER_HECTOR.name: Hector
messages: I have a rare Pokémon!\nWould you like me to show you?{be01}
You…\nYou want my Pokémon, don’t you?
I have this rare Pokémon.\nIt’s enough to keep me satisfied.

TRAINER_HECTOR_1.name: Hector
messages: I have a rare Pokémon!\nWould you like me to show you?{be01}
You…\nYou want my Pokémon, don’t you?
I have this rare Pokémon.\nIt’s enough to keep me satisfied.

TRAINER_HEIDI.name: Heidi
messages: I’m having a picnic in the desert.{be01}\nYou can always find a Trainer,\nso I can enjoy a battle here, too!{be01}
Ohhh! You’re mean!

When you’re battling in a sandstorm,
watch out for your Pokémon’s HP.{be01}
It can faint if you don’t keep
an eye on it!

TRAINER_HELENE.name: Helene
messages: My Pokémon have black belt-level\nstrength!{be01}
This is too humiliating!

I rarely meet anyone who’s better
than me…{be01}
I get it now!
You’re a Gym Leader, aren’t you?

TRAINER_HENRY.name: Henry
messages: Whoops! Don’t tell me I snagged\na Surfing Pokémon?{be01}
I can’t keep up!
It’d be a handful if I hooked\nyour tough Pokémon!

TRAINER_HERMAN.name: Herman
messages: The sea… The sea… The sea…\nThe sea as far as these eyes can see!{be00}\nI’m sick and tired of the sea!{be01}
Bleah!
Bored I am by the sea, but swim I must.{be01}\nI’m a born swimmer!\nThat’s what I am.

TRAINER_HIDEKI.name: Takao
messages: Might is right!\nCome on!{be01}
Not enough power…
Your skill overcame my strength!\nYour technique is commendable!

TRAINER_HIDEO.name: Hideo
messages: To hide a tree, use a forest!{be01}
I bow to your superiority.

To hide a tree, use a forest!
To hide a Pokémon, use a Pokémon!{be01}
There is no deep, hidden meaning
to that.

TRAINER_HIDEO_2.name: Hideo
messages: To hide a tree, use a forest!{be01}
I bow to your superiority.

To hide a tree, use a forest!
To hide a Pokémon, use a Pokémon!{be01}
There is no deep, hidden meaning
to that.

TRAINER_HITOSHI.name: Hitoshi
messages: You’re a Pokémon Trainer.\nNo need for words. We battle now.{be01}
It was I who challenged you, and yet\nI lost. I am deeply shamed…

TRAINER_HOPE.name: Hope
messages: This seemingly infinite and harsh road\nlives up to its name of Victory.{be01}
Your battle style is fantastic…
You seem to have the potential for\nbecoming the Champion.

TRAINER_HUDSON.name: Hudson
messages: Listen, have you seen another Sailor\naround here?{be01}
Now, that’s something!
Our boat drifted out to sea.{be01}\nMy buddy’s a timid fellow, so I’m\nworried about him.

TRAINER_HUEY.name: Huey
messages: I’ve laid anchor in ports around\nthe world, but Slateport’s the best.{be01}
You’re the best!
In the best port was the best\nTrainer…

TRAINER_HUGH.name: Hugh
messages: The vast sky holds untold promise!{be01}\nNothing can compare to the sheer\nexhilaration of flight!{be01}
Down and out!
My Bird Pokémon made my dreams of\nflying come true!

TRAINER_HUMBERTO.name: Humberto
messages: Urk!\nI couldn’t stop you.
You’d better watch it!\nDon’t get distracted staring at Winona{be00}\nor you’ll go crashing down in a heap!

TRAINER_IMANI.name: Imani
messages: The blue, blue sky…\nThe vast sea…{be00}\nIt’s so peaceful…{be01}
I lost while I was lounging!
I want to be told I’m relaxing to be\nwith. Giggle.

TRAINER_IRENE.name: Irene
messages: I don’t know where you’re going,\nbut would you like to battle?{be01}
Oh, you’re disgustingly good!
I’m thinking that I should go to\nMt. Chimney, but the view around{be00}\nhere is very nice, too.

TRAINER_ISAAC_1.name: Isaac
messages: Listen, could I get you to battle\nthe Pokémon I’m raising?{be01}
You’ve raised yours superbly…

TRAINER_ISABELLA.name: Isabella
messages: I’m not going to lose to some\nsurfer Trainer.{be01}
I’ve only got sweat in my eyes!\nI am not crying!
You can find pretty colored shards\nof things around here.

TRAINER_ISABELLE.name: Isabelle
messages: Watch where you’re going!\nWe’re going to crash!{be01}
Groan…
I’m a poor swimmer so I was practicing…\nSorry for almost crashing into you.

TRAINER_ISABEL_1.name: Isabel
messages: Ahahaha! I would go anywhere to show\noff my delightful Pokémon.{be01}
Oh, dear, this won’t do.
Rather than battling, perhaps I should\nshow off my Pokémon at the Fan Club.

TRAINER_ISABEL_2.name: Celina
messages: Show me how to put a little excitement\ninto my life.{be01}
Oh… My…\nThat was too much excitement.
My pulse is still racing.\nYou’re one fabulous Trainer.

TRAINER_ISABEL_3.name: Bianca
messages: Did you come from Mauville?\nThen you should be full of energy!{be01}
Ooh lala!\nThat’s a lot to take!
This road here…\nYou have quite a ways to travel.

TRAINER_ISABEL_4.name: Hayden
messages: When you’re as famished as I am,\nthere is no room for pity!{be01}
Groan…
My stomach is grumbling!\nMaybe I can grill some Berries…

TRAINER_ISABEL_5.name: Sophie
messages: The warmth here is making me drowsy.\nBattle with me so I can stay awake.{be01}
This is a dream.\nI’m sure of it…
Losing burns me up…\nI’m just going to sleep right here!{be00}\nZzz!

TRAINER_ISAIAH_1.name: Isaiah
messages: Ever Grande City is still a long ways\naway…{be01}
My first victory seems to be far\naway, too…
My whole life has been about losing,\nbut I will never give up!

TRAINER_ISAIAH_2.name: Carolina
messages: I take huge pride in my Pokémon.\nWe’ll show you one speedy battle!{be01}
That wasn’t cute at all.
Since I’m at sea like this, I wouldn’t\nmind putting on a pink, frilly swimsuit…

TRAINER_ISAIAH_3.name: Elijah
messages: For a guy as macho as me, this kind\nof Pokémon is the perfect match!{be01}
I’m cool even in defeat, hey?
For a guy as macho as me, a port\nis the perfect setting!{be01}\nI guess I’ll head for Slateport.

TRAINER_ISAIAH_4.name: Celia
messages: I shouldn’t have come to a place like\nthis for a picnic!{be01}
Aww!\nI really shouldn’t have come!
In a sandstorm like this, I can’t set\nthe places for a picnic even with my{be00}\nGo-Goggles on…

TRAINER_ISAIAH_5.name: Bryan
messages: How tough are you?\nWe shall expose that secret!{be01}
Oh! Your strength!\nIt is shrouded in mystery!
This desert hoards mysteries in\nits shifting sands!

TRAINER_ISOBEL.name: Isobel
messages: If seawater gets up your nose,\ndoesn’t it feel terrible?{be01}
Ack! Why, you…\nGlub!
Ooh, I choked on some water!\nIt’s bitter! It’s salty!!

TRAINER_IVAN.name: Ivan
messages: I thought I wasn’t too bad, if I may\nsay so, but I guess not… Bleah…
I got too into fishing.\nI forgot I had to raise my Pokémon…

TRAINER_JACE.name: Jace
messages: Come on, get with it!\nLet’s go before my feelings cool!{be01}
It’s so hot, and yet my heart is\nclutched by ice…
The way the battling spirit burns\nwithin you, you may stand a chance{be00}\nagainst our Leader.

TRAINER_JACK.name: Jack
messages: Even those Pokémon that can swim are\ncarried along by the rapid currents.{be01}
Aiyeeeeh!
I think Pokémon enjoy the fast-running\ncurrents around these parts.

TRAINER_JACKI_1.name: Jacki
messages: Overwhelmed!
We all have psychic powers.\nWe’ve just forgotten how to use them.

TRAINER_JACKI_2.name: Grunt
messages: We should’ve taken a break…\nThat’s what we should’ve done…

TRAINER_JACKI_3.name: Macey
messages: You’re not getting through to the end!\nNot if I can help it!{be01}
How could you be so ludicrously\nstrong?
Humph! You may be strong, but you’re\nnot suitable for the Psychic type!{be01}\nThe way you battle is somehow brutal!

TRAINER_JACKI_4.name: Brendan
messages: Hmm…\nYou’re pretty good.

TRAINER_JACKI_5.name: Brendan
messages: Hmm…\nYou’re pretty good.

TRAINER_JACKSON_1.name: Jackson
messages: Who has the knowledge and\nthe technique for survival?{be01}\nPokémon Rangers, that’s who!{be01}
I didn’t have enough Pokémon\nknow-how…
To break away from civilization and\nawaken the wild spirit within!{be01}\nThat’s our vision.

TRAINER_JACLYN.name: Jaclyn
messages: Ahahahaha!\nI’ll dazzle you with my wonders!{be01}
I wondrously lost!
You managed to win only because it was\na wonder! Yes, a wonder!{be00}\nDon’t think you can win all the time!

TRAINER_JACOB.name: Jacob
messages: Whoa! Watch it!\nI guess you’re not used to Bike racing.{be01}
Whoa!\nMy brakes failed!
Flat tires and brake problems can\ncause serious injury!{be00}\nInspect your Bike for problems!

TRAINER_JAIDEN.name: Jaiden
messages: Take that!\nUltra Pokémon ninja attack!{be01}
Waaah!\nOur strategy failed!
But my Pokémon were ultra,\nweren’t they?

TRAINER_JAMES_1.name: James
messages: If you take Bug Pokémon to school,\nyou get to be instantly popular!{be01}
I can’t be popular if I lose.
If you have a big Bug Pokémon,\npeople respect you for it.

TRAINER_JANI.name: Jani
messages: I’m not good at swimming,\nbut I am good at battles!{be01}
Oops.\nThat didn’t go very well.
Walking around barefoot in this ship\nis kind of gross.

TRAINER_JANICE.name: Janice
messages: Let me teach you how strong my\nadorable Pokémon is!{be01}
You’re a notch above me…
Pokémon that possess cuteness and\npower, that’s ideal, I think.

TRAINER_JARED.name: Jared
messages: Behold the elegant battle style of\nBird Pokémon!{be01}
You…\nYou’re strong…

A Trainer has to be smart to keep
up with unexpected turns of events.{be01}
Do you have the smarts to get to
our Leader?

TRAINER_JASMINE.name: Jasmine
messages: I’ve been riding without stopping.\nMy thighs are like rocks!{be01}
I’m worried about muscle cramps…
Oh, you have some Gym Badges?\nNo wonder you’re so strong!

TRAINER_JAYLEN.name: Jaylen
messages: Can you guess why it’s so cool\naround here?{be01}
Peeuuw!\nThat stinks!
The volcanic ash blocks the sun,\nso it doesn’t get very warm.{be01}\nThat’s good for me--I can’t stand heat!

TRAINER_JAZMYN.name: Jazmyn
messages: My confidence will get a boost by\nbeating someone obviously strong!{be01}
There goes my confidence…
They say that you can’t judge a person\nby their appearance.{be01}\nBut often, their looks don’t lie…

TRAINER_JEFF.name: Jeff
messages: See how the flames blaze wildly?\nThey flare in anticipation of my win!{be01}
Something didn’t go right.
Well, so what? I say so what?\nI can walk on hot coals barefoot!{be01}\n…Don’t even think about trying it!

TRAINER_JEFFREY_1.name: Jeffrey
messages: … … … … … …\n… … … … … …{be00}\nWant to battle?{be01}
Lost it…
… … … … … …\n… … … … … …{be00}\nI’ll try harder…

TRAINER_JENNA.name: Jenna
messages: How’s your physical fitness?\nIf you’re not fit, you could have a{be00}\nrough time in critical situations.{be01}
I’m totally fit, but…
Fitness training is in my routine.\nI always run with my Pokémon.

TRAINER_JENNIFER.name: Jennifer
messages: Pokémon have many special abilities.\nIf you want to become a first-class{be00}\nTrainer, learn about them.{be01}
You’re obviously thinking.
The special abilities of Pokémon\nwill make battle styles change.

TRAINER_JENNY_1.name: Jenny
messages: If you just float in the sea like\nthis, Pokémon come around to play.{be01}
Oh, darn.\nI’ve gone and lost.

While swimming, I noticed that some
Pokémon attack, and some just watch.{be01}
I guess Pokémon have personalities
of their own.

TRAINER_JENNY_2.name: May
messages: Yikes!\nYou’re better than I expected!

TRAINER_JENNY_3.name: Angelo
messages: I love shiny things!{be01}
Oh…\nMy eyes are frazzled…
Mauville Gym’s Wattson has a shiny\nforehead. It makes me happy!

TRAINER_JENNY_4.name: Darius
messages: You’d better know that there are all\nsorts of Flying-type Pokémon.{be01}\nYou do know that, right?{be01}
You seem to know your stuff!
Sure, you beat me all right.\nBut you’d better watch it! Our Leader{be00}\nWinona’s Pokémon are all business.

TRAINER_JENNY_5.name: Steven
messages: You…\nI had no idea you’d become so strong…

TRAINER_JEROME.name: Jerome
messages: My dream is to swim the world’s seven\nseas!{be01}
I won’t be able to swim the seven seas\nlike this…
Playing with marine Pokémon is one of\nthe pleasures of swimming!

TRAINER_JERRY_1.name: Jerry
messages: We learn all sorts of things at the\nTrainer’s School.{be01}\nI want to test things out for real!{be01}
I slacked off in school…\nThat’s why I lost.
I’ll have to redo some courses at\nthe Trainer’s School.{be00}\nIf I don’t, Roxanne will be steamed.

TRAINER_JERRY_2.name: Jonathan
messages: Someone’s been watching me intently.\nWas it you?{be01}
Wow!\nThat’s pretty strong, all right!
I can’t shake this feeling that\nsomeone’s watching me.{be01}\nI can’t concentrate!

TRAINER_JERRY_3.name: Brendan
messages: Hmm…\nYou’re pretty good.

TRAINER_JERRY_4.name: May
messages: Yikes!\nYou’re better than I expected!

TRAINER_JERRY_5.name: Maxie
messages: What makes you so adept at handling\nPokémon?

TRAINER_JESSICA_1.name: Jessica
messages: Stop! Have a good look at my precious\nPokémon!{be01}
Oh, how dare you!\nDon’t take it so seriously!
Maybe I’ll go catch more Pokémon at\nthe Safari.

TRAINER_JESSICA_2.name: Carlee
messages: The sunlight seems to be more harsh\nin this area.{be01}
I couldn’t see very well because of\nthe sun’s glare.
I should go back soon.\nI need to reapply my sunscreen.

TRAINER_JESSICA_3.name: Cedric
messages: Have you lost your bearings?\nHave no fear for I am here!{be01}
Weren’t you lost?
I had this feeling that a lost Trainer\nwould be panicked and easy to beat.{be01}\nIt’s dirty and I won’t try it again…

TRAINER_JESSICA_4.name: Eli
messages: As much as I love mountains,\nI especially love volcanoes.{be01}
Well, it seems to me I lost without\never being in control.
I stay here because I became a fan\nof Flannery’s power.{be01}\nHehehehe.

TRAINER_JESSICA_5.name: Annika
messages: I can battle with really rare Pokémon\nif you’d like.{be01}
Oh, there now! Did you have a good look\nat my Pokémon?

I came to this Gym because Juan
praised me for my darling Pokémon.{be01}
Oh, if only I’d met Juan years ago
when I was younger…

TRAINER_JILL.name: Paula
messages: The Trick House is getting trickier,\nisn’t it?{be01}
Aaak!
Has anyone made it to the end?

TRAINER_JOCELYN.name: Jocelyn
messages: There’s no need for Brawly to be\ninvolved!{be01}\nI’ll crush you!{be01}
But… How?\nHow could I lose so easily?

TRAINER_JODY.name: Jody
messages: But… I went all out!

The way you use your Pokémon…
It’s like your father’s style.{be01}
Go on through! The Gym Leader, your
father, is waiting!

TRAINER_JOEY.name: Joey
messages: My Pokémon rule!\nCheck them out!{be01}
Ouch! A scrape!\nI have to put on a bandage!
Bandages are signs of toughness!\nI’ve got another one!

TRAINER_JOHANNA.name: Johanna
messages: Boring battles aren’t worth the effort.{be01}\nFiery hot battles are what toughen up\nTrainers and Pokémon!{be01}
That’s hot!
Whew, I’m all thirsty.\nMaybe I’ll have a Soda Pop.

TRAINER_JOHNSON.name: Johnson
messages: It’s a dead end up here.\nI’m bored, so can we battle?{be01}
That was fun even though I lost.
Want to stay here and keep\nme company?

TRAINER_JOHN_AND_JAY_1.name: John & Jay
messages: John: We’ve always battled Pokémon\ntogether as a twosome.{be00}\nWe’ve confidence in ourselves.{be01}

John: Oh, my.
We’ve lost, dear wife.{be01}
Jay: Oh, dear.
We’ve lost, my dear husband.

John: We’ve been married for
fifty years.{be01}
Come to think of it, I’ve yet to beat
my dear wife in a battle.

TRAINER_ROSE_3.name: Gabrielle
messages: Why have you come here?{be01}
That was amazing!\nYou’re a very special Trainer.

TRAINER_ROSE_4.name: Marcel
messages: My Pokémon have never tasted defeat!\nOn their next win, I’m entering them{be00}\nin Contests.{be01}
Oh, now what happened here?
I may have to train my gang some more\nbefore entering any Contest.

TRAINER_ROSE_5.name: Alberto
messages: Even in defeat, Bird Pokémon are cool!

I gather Bird Pokémon feathers that
scatter during battles.{be01}
I’m going to make a hat with
Bird Pokémon feathers.

TRAINER_ROXANNE.name: Roxanne
messages:
Since you are so strong, you should
challenge other Gym Leaders.{be01}
By battling many Trainers, you should
learn many things.

TRAINER_ROXANNE_1.name: Roxanne
messages:
Since you are so strong, you should
challenge other Gym Leaders.{be01}
By battling many Trainers, you should
learn many things.

TRAINER_RUBEN.name: Ruben
messages: There is no stronger Trainer than I!{be01}
This can’t be!
There probably is no stronger Trainer\nthan you!

TRAINER_SADIE.name: Danielle
messages: Um…\nOkay, I’ll battle with you.{be01}
Oh, but you’re too strong.
I’m going to be a pretty and strong\nTrainer just like Flannery.

TRAINER_SALLY.name: Sally
messages: I’ll hack and slash my way to victory\nwith the Cut we just learned!{be01}
Why are you so serious?
I never get tired of hacking\nand slashing!

TRAINER_SAMANTHA.name: Samantha
messages: I surrender!

You will wage a terrifically intense
battle with our Gym Leaders…{be01}
The result…
You won’t hear it from me!

TRAINER_SAMUEL.name: Samuel
messages: The thought that I’m getting closer to\nthe Pokémon League…{be01}\nI’m getting stage fright…{be01}
I couldn’t do a thing…
The Pokémon League became distant\nagain… What a letdown…

TRAINER_SANTIAGO.name: Santiago
messages: Floating on the open sea like this…\nIt’s peaceful.{be01}
I needed to be a little less peaceful!
Swimming and battling like this…\nI’m one happy guy…

TRAINER_SARAH.name: Sarah
messages: Just so you know, I’ve never once been\nbested by anyone at anything.{be01}
Oh, my goodness.\nThis is a new experience for me.

My life of luxury affords me all that
I could possibly desire.{be01}
However, when it comes to Pokémon,
my wealth has no meaning.

TRAINER_SAWYER_1.name: Sawyer
messages: This is one fine mountain! Plenty of\nhot people around for company!{be01}
Oh, you’re a real firebrand, too!
I think I need a dip in Lavaridge\nHot Spring with the locals!

TRAINER_SEBASTIAN.name: Sebastian
messages: I’m getting dizzy from these rotating\ndoors…{be01}
Everything’s spinning around and\naround. I can’t take this anymore…
You don’t seem to be affected at all.\nOr do you have your poker face on?

TRAINER_SHANE.name: Shane
messages: Way too strong!
I think it’s great that I can go\ncamping with my Pokémon.

TRAINER_SHANNON.name: Shannon
messages: To win your way through the Pokémon\nLeague, you need the trust of your{be00}\nPokémon.{be01}
Your relationship is based on\nsolid trust.
By being together all the time, trust\ngrows between Pokémon and Trainers.

TRAINER_SHARON.name: Sharon
messages: How would you like to take on the\nWater-type Pokémon I raised?{be01}
Lost it…
Your power… You’re the real deal.\nI’m amazed!

TRAINER_SHAWN.name: Shawn
messages: I trained under Wattson!\nThere ain’t no way I’ll lose easily!{be01}
Unplugged and turned off…

Wattson, our Gym Leader, has been
around for a long, long time.{be01}
He was battling even before your
daddy was born, that tough coot.

TRAINER_SHAYLA.name: Shayla
messages: Oh, aren’t you an adorable Trainer!\nPlease, I need a romantic battle!{be00}\nI’m somewhat decent!{be01}
Oh, how strong you are!\nYou’ve given me quite a shock!

TRAINER_SHEILA.name: Sheila
messages: I’ve finally made it to Mt. Chimney.\nI want to make my Pokémon battle!{be01}
The way you battle…\nIt’s like a Mt. Chimney eruption!

TRAINER_SHELBY_1.name: Shelby
messages: I’ve been to the hot springs and\nrefreshed my tired bones.{be00}\nRight now I’m feeling strong!{be01}
Oh, my goodness.\nNow, aren’t you something!
Well, well, I’ve lost. I can’t call\nmyself an Expert now, can I?

TRAINER_SHELBY_2.name: Kai
messages: I landed a big one!\nA huge one, I tell you!{be01}
What was that about?\nDid mine lose in size?
Okay!\nI’ll just fish me a bigger one!

TRAINER_SHELBY_3.name: Charlotte
messages: Me!\nI’m not just a pretty face!{be01}
That wasn’t cute in the least!

I don’t want a Pokémon that’s
just cute.{be01}
I adore cute ones that have a quirk
or two!

TRAINER_SHELBY_4.name: Deandre
messages: Go, go, go!\nPokémon 1, 2, and 3!{be01}
Come in, Pokémon! Are you okay?\nPokémon 1, 2, and 3?!
Isn’t it cool that I have a Pokémon\nbattle team?{be01}\nYou can copy me--I don’t mind!

TRAINER_SHELBY_5.name: Grunt
messages: I’m always late for training sessions,\ntoo!{be01}\nI hate to say it, but I’m wimpy…
Okay, I’ll try to put a little more\neffort into things from now on…

TRAINER_SHELLY_1.name: Shelly
messages: Ahahahaha!\nYou’re disgustingly strong!

It’s bad enough to have Team Magma
blunder about, but now there’s you!{be01}
What makes you want to sniff around
in our business, anyway?

TRAINER_SHELLY_2.name: Shelly
messages: Ahahahaha!{be01}\nOuch!

TRAINER_SHELLY_SEAFLOOR_CAVERN.name: Shelly
messages: Ahahahaha!{be01}\nOuch!

TRAINER_SHELLY_WEATHER_INSTITUTE.name: Shelly
messages: Ahahahaha!\nYou’re disgustingly strong!

It’s bad enough to have Team Magma
blunder about, but now there’s you!{be01}
What makes you want to sniff around
in our business, anyway?

TRAINER_SHIRLEY.name: Shirley
messages: Since I bathed in the hot springs,\nI’ve been feeling great!{be00}\nI’m sure I’m going to win!{be01}
Yowch!\nI’m getting a chill out of the water.
I’ll have to take another dip in the\nhot springs. Want to join me?{be01}\nJust joking!

TRAINER_SIDNEY.name: Sidney
messages: Well, how do you like that? I lost!\nEh, it was fun, so it doesn’t matter.

TRAINER_SIENNA.name: Sienna
messages: I’m throwing my whole heart\ninto this!{be01}
You had more heart!
I need to cool down now…\nI think I’ll go for a dive.

TRAINER_SIMON.name: Simon
messages: I’m going to show you how great\nmy Pokémon are, but don’t cry!{be01}
…I lost, but I won’t cry…
If one of my Pokémon knew the move\nfor carrying me across water on its{be00}\nback, I could get rid of this inner tube.

TRAINER_SOPHIA.name: Sophia
messages: When I heard there was a strange\nhouse, I had to check it out.{be01}
I’ve discovered a tough Trainer!

I’m sure having a good time checking
this place out.{be01}
It’s a challenge I’ve found worth
repeating!

TRAINER_SOPHIE.name: Sophie
messages: The warmth here is making me drowsy.\nBattle with me so I can stay awake.{be01}
This is a dream.\nI’m sure of it…
Losing burns me up…\nI’m just going to sleep right here!{be00}\nZzz!

TRAINER_SPENCER.name: Spencer
messages: Hey, are you lost at sea?{be01}\nIf you can beat my Pokémon,\nI can serve as your pilot.{be01}
I lost my bearings in battle!
Many people lose their bearings at sea.{be01}\nIf you’re that sort, you should refer\nto the PokéNav’s Map.

TRAINER_STAN.name: Stan
messages: Hey, there!\nCheck out my sweet Pokémon!{be01}
I floundered…
I was blown away by Horsea’s charm,\nso I started swimming, too.

TRAINER_STEVEN.name: Wallace

TRAINER_STEVEN_EMERALD.name: Steven
messages: You…\nI had no idea you’d become so strong…

TRAINER_STEVE_1.name: Steve
messages: Ufufufufufu…\nWant to battle against my Pokémon?{be01}
M-My Pokémon…

A big body that’s all lumpy and hard,
enormous horns, and vicious fangs…{be01}
Ufufufufu…
I wish I had a Pokémon like that…

TRAINER_STEVE_2.name: Kelvin
messages: O-our boat!\nThe tide carried it away!{be01}
Awawawawah!\nPlease, stop! Please!

If we can’t Surf, how are we supposed
to get home?{be01}
Actually, I know a fainted Pokémon
can still Surf, but it feels wrong.

TRAINER_STEVE_3.name: Marley
messages: Can your Pokémon dodge our\nlightning-quick attacks?{be01}
I never knew such a technique existed!\nYou’ve defeated us thoroughly.
I haven’t lost my passion for speed.\nI will try harder.

TRAINER_STEVE_4.name: Reyna
messages: My Pokémon can’t be taken down\neasily!{be01}
You’re kidding!\nExplain how I lost!

Haha!
You won, all right!{be01}
I’ll work my way back up by taking on
Trainers I happen to meet!

TRAINER_STEVE_5.name: Hudson
messages: Listen, have you seen another Sailor\naround here?{be01}
Now, that’s something!
Our boat drifted out to sea.{be01}\nMy buddy’s a timid fellow, so I’m\nworried about him.

TRAINER_SUSIE.name: Susie
messages: Hi, sweetie, wait!\nWe should battle, you and I!{be01}
You’re tough in spite of the way\nyou look!

Did you see a guy over there who whines
that he’s bored of the sea?{be01}
That’s all talk.
He’s hopelessly in love with the sea!

TRAINER_SYLVIA.name: Sylvia
messages: Even at the risk of life, I will win\nthis battle!{be01}
What you do…\nIt horrifies me…
How dare you beat me…{be01}\nIt won’t be my fault if something\nhorrible befalls you…

TRAINER_TABITHA_MAGMA_HIDEOUT.name: Tabitha
messages: Taken down again…\nHehe…
…And while you wasted time with me,\nMaxie should have awakened Groudon…

TRAINER_TABITHA_MOSSDEEP.name: Tabitha
messages: I’m with our leader…

TRAINER_TABITHA_MT_CHIMNEY.name: Tabitha
messages: Hehehe…{be01}\nEven though I’ve lost, if our leader\nawakens that thing…
Boss, hurry!\nGive it the Meteorite’s energy!{be01}\nHehehe…

TRAINER_TAKAO.name: Takao
messages: Might is right!\nCome on!{be01}
Not enough power…
Your skill overcame my strength!\nYour technique is commendable!

TRAINER_TAKASHI.name: Takashi
messages: If you’re not on your guard,\nyou’re in for some pain!{be01}
You’re surprisingly good!
My surprise attack ended in\nfailure…

TRAINER_TALIA.name: Talia
messages: If you can beat me, I’ll give you some\ngreat information!{be01}
Oh?\nDid I lose?
There is an odd place nearby.\nThere’s a huge tower there.{be00}\nWhy don’t you go take a look?

TRAINER_TAMMY.name: Tammy
messages: There are powers beyond our\nunderstanding in the world…{be01}
I have lost…
Mt. Pyre…\nThere is a mysterious power{be00}\nat work there…

TRAINER_TANYA.name: Tanya
messages: I’m tired of swimming.\nAre you up for a battle with me?{be01}
You’re too much!
Whew…\nWhich way is it to Mossdeep City?

TRAINER_TARA.name: Tara
messages: My liar of a boyfriend told me that\nI look great in a bikini…{be01}
Oh, boo!
Even if it’s a lie, I love being told\nI look great…{be00}\nWe girls are so complex…

TRAINER_TASHA.name: Tasha
messages: Losing, I dislike…

I want to see dreadful things…
I can’t leave…{be01}
Stay…
Won’t you stay with me?

TRAINER_TATE_AND_LIZA.name: Tate
messages: Tate: What?! Our combination…\nLiza: Was shattered!

TRAINER_TATE_AND_LIZA_1.name: Tate
messages: Tate: What?! Our combination…\nLiza: Was shattered!

TRAINER_TAYLOR.name: Taylor
messages: If you step forward, we step forward.{be01}\nIf you turn right, we turn, too…{be01}
But if you win, I lose…
I can’t Mimic you winning the match.\nThat’s just impossible…{be00}\nIt’s burning me up…

TRAINER_TED.name: Ted
messages: Which switch closes which hole?{be01}
After that battle, I’m even more\nconfused!
Can I get you to push all the buttons\nfor me?

TRAINER_TERRELL.name: Flint
messages: There’s no need for Winona, our Gym\nLeader, to deal with you!{be01}\nI’m plenty good enough for you!{be01}
Winona, I…\nI lost!
Winona is cute and she’s strong.\nShe’s the ultimate Leader!{be01}\nBlush…

TRAINER_TESSA.name: Jocelyn
messages: There’s no need for Brawly to be\ninvolved!{be01}\nI’ll crush you!{be01}
But… How?\nHow could I lose so easily?

TRAINER_THALIA_1.name: Thalia
messages: What on earth would compel you to\ncome here? You must be curious!{be01}
Not just curious, but also strong…
The man next door…{be01}\nHe says he’s just sightseeing,\nbut I don’t know about that.

TRAINER_THOMAS.name: Thomas
messages: Child…\nDid you knock on the door?{be01}
A loss is to be accepted without haste\nor panic.
To be never ruffled in any situation is\nthe Gentleman’s code of conduct.

TRAINER_TIANA.name: Tiana
messages: I’m going to keep winning and aim\nto be the best Trainer.{be01}\nHelp me further my career!{be01}
I ended up furthering your career…
To keep winning my way up, I see that\nI have to catch more Pokémon.

TRAINER_TIFFANY.name: Tiffany
messages: Well, excuse me?!
This is really obvious, but how strong\nyou are as a Trainer has nothing to do{be00}\nwith how young or old you are.

TRAINER_TIMMY.name: Timmy
messages: I found some cool Pokémon in the grass\naround here!{be01}
Being cool isn’t enough to win…
It’s hard to battle with Pokémon you\njust caught.

TRAINER_TIMOTHY_1.name: Timothy
messages: Hm…\nYou seem rather capable…{be00}\nLet me keep you company!{be01}
You’re much stronger than\nI’d imagined!
There is no such thing as a born genius.\nIt all depends on effort!{be00}\nThat is what I believe…

TRAINER_TIMOTHY_2.name: Coby
messages: Pfft, with these wings I can\nflick you away!{be01}
A… What?
I don’t know what to say when I get\nbeaten so easily…

TRAINER_TIMOTHY_3.name: Lawrence
messages: Were you maybe in the middle\nof gathering volcanic ashes?{be01}
Ehehe.\nWe got beaten cleanly.
I ought to hide under the ashes, too.

TRAINER_TIMOTHY_4.name: Wyatt
messages: Y-you want to battle with me?\nEven though I just caught my Pokémon?{be01}
Y-you’re all happy to win?\nEven though it’s only me?

Oh, so now you want to say a word to
the loser?{be01}
Aren’t you just the coolest?
Humph!

TRAINER_TIMOTHY_5.name: Angelina
messages: Have you made your Pokémon evolve\nvery much?{be01}
Oh, I see.\nThat’s good to know.
Some Pokémon change so much when\nthey evolve, it’s startling!

TRAINER_TISHA.name: Tisha
messages: What’s the hurry?\nLet’s take it slow and easy.{be01}
Oh, my.\nI wanted to relax a little more…

Don’t you hate making mistakes when
you’re in a rush?{be01}
That’s why I try to take things
slowly.

TRAINER_TOMMY.name: Tommy
messages: If you can’t beat me, you won’t stand\na chance against Roxanne!{be01}
Wow! You’ve got some potential!
Roxanne is stronger than me by\nseveral times.{be01}\nYou’d better be on your guard!

TRAINER_TONY_1.name: Tony
messages: The sea is like my backyard.\nLet’s battle!{be01}
I lost on my home field…\nI’m in shock!

I swim the seas with a heart full of
dreams…{be01}
It’s a song!
Anyways, I’m swimming some more.

TRAINER_TONY_2.name: Conor
messages: Young people are too happy to go with\nthe flow. They’re without direction.{be01}
You have a firm sense of purpose.
Don’t let others lead you astray.\nDon’t lose direction as you grow older.

TRAINER_TONY_3.name: Tabitha
messages: I’m with our leader…

TRAINER_TONY_4.name: Davis
messages: This is my awesome Bug Pokémon!\nMy big brother got it for me.{be01}
Waaaah!\nYou meanie!
Don’t tell my brother I lost.\nYou have to keep it a secret!

TRAINER_TONY_5.name: Mitchell
messages: My Pokémon are cosmically\nawe inspiring!{be01}
I’ve never met anyone like you before.
Even outside of battle, I sense\nincredible power emanating from you{be00}\nand your Pokémon.

TRAINER_TORI_AND_TIA.name: Tori & Tia
messages: Tori: Both of us, we collect ashes.\nWe battle Pokémon, too.{be01}

Tori: We lost… It’s boring, so I’m going
to get some more ashes.{be01}
Tia: We couldn’t win… It’s boring,
so I’m getting some more ashes.
Tori: How much ash do we have?\nEnough for a White Flute, I hope.
Tori: We want to battle 2-on-2.\nIf we didn’t, we would lose!
Tia: Both of us, we collect ashes.\nWe battle Pokémon, too.{be01}
Tia: We have a lot of ashes!\nI think enough for a White Flute!
Tia: We want to battle 2-on-2.\nIf we don’t, we won’t win!

TRAINER_TRAVIS.name: Travis
messages: I’m full of pep!\nAnd my Pokémon is peppy, too!{be01}
My Pokémon lost its pep…
When I see a Trainer with a lot of pep,\nI can’t help looking.

TRAINER_TRENT_1.name: Trent
messages: Ouch! My legs cramped up!

TRAINER_TSUNAO.name: Riley
messages: We ninja conceal ourselves under our\ncamouflage cloaks.{be00}\nI bet you didn’t know where I was!{be01}
I lost!\nI should camouflage my shame!
Our camouflage cloaks are all\nhandmade.

TRAINER_TUCKER.name: Micah
messages: Are your friends strong?{be01}
Your friends are, indeed, strong.
Friends need not be human.\nFor me, Pokémon are treasured friends!

TRAINER_TYRA_AND_IVY.name: Tyra & Ivy
messages: Tyra: Well, sure.\nI’m in the mood for it.{be00}\nI’ll teach you a little about Pokémon.{be01}
Tyra: What an amazing battle style!{be01}\nIvy: What an amazing battle style!
Tyra: I was teaching my junior Ivy\nabout Pokémon.
Tyra: Giggle…\nIf you want to battle with us, just one{be00}\nPokémon isn’t enough!
Ivy: Who taught you about Pokémon?{be01}
Ivy: I started training Pokémon\nbecause Tyra, my student mentor,{be00}\ntaught me!
Ivy: Do you only have one Pokémon?\nI think it must feel lonesome.

TRAINER_TYRON.name: Tyron
messages: This is my favorite kind of Pokémon!{be01}
Wait!\nDid you get a good look at my Pokémon?

When having a battle, I get a kick out
of showing off my Pokémon.{be01}
I bet everyone feels that way when
they enter a battle!

TRAINER_VALERIE_1.name: Valerie
messages: When I’m here…\nA curious power flows into me…{be01}
The power is ebbing away…
Perhaps the power is from the spirits\nof Pokémon in fitful sleep here…

TRAINER_VALERIE_2.name: Pablo
messages: Check out this sculpted body!\nI’m more cut than a Black Belt!{be01}
Whoops! Too strong!\nNot bad! Not bad at all!
Losing to you stimulated my senses!\nI’ll train myself and Pokémon harder!

TRAINER_VALERIE_3.name: Isobel
messages: If seawater gets up your nose,\ndoesn’t it feel terrible?{be01}
Ack! Why, you…\nGlub!
Ooh, I choked on some water!\nIt’s bitter! It’s salty!!

TRAINER_VALERIE_4.name: Talia
messages: If you can beat me, I’ll give you some\ngreat information!{be01}
Oh?\nDid I lose?
There is an odd place nearby.\nThere’s a huge tower there.{be00}\nWhy don’t you go take a look?

TRAINER_VALERIE_5.name: Humberto
messages: Urk!\nI couldn’t stop you.
You’d better watch it!\nDon’t get distracted staring at Winona{be00}\nor you’ll go crashing down in a heap!

TRAINER_VANESSA.name: Vanessa
messages: Will you play with my delightfully\npretty Pokémon?{be01}
This isn’t what I meant!
I’m going to a Contest in Lilycove.{be01}\nMy Pokémon should have no problem\nsweeping the Master Class.

TRAINER_VICKY.name: Vicky
messages: Kwah! You are strong…\nMy granddaughter was right…
If you’re not in any hurry,\nvisit with us awhile.

TRAINER_VICTOR.name: Victor
messages: Aiyah!\nYou’re a lot tougher than I expected!
Hey, all!\nI’ve found a pretty strong Trainer!

TRAINER_VICTORIA.name: Victoria
messages: Oh, gosh!\nI can’t get over how strong you are!
There’s a strong Trainer here!\nThis one’s really strong!

TRAINER_VINCENT.name: Vincent
messages: Not many Trainers have made it\nthis far.{be01}
That must mean you’re tough, too…
You’ve beaten the Pokémon League\nChampion? That’s too much!

TRAINER_VIOLET.name: Violet
messages: They say that good times are filled\nwith good aromas.{be01}
Oh…\nI smell the bitter scent of misery…
The Berry Master’s garden is filled\nwith uplifting fragrances.

TRAINER_VIRGIL.name: Virgil
messages: Let me see your talent!{be01}
You possess spectacular talent!

If there are prodigies in the world,
then our Gym Leaders are them!{be01}
However, you may be even more talented
than them…

TRAINER_VITO.name: Vito
messages: I trained together with my whole family,\nevery one of us!{be00}\nI’m not losing to anyone!{be01}
Better than my family?!\nIs that possible?!

I was better than everyone in my
family. I’ve never lost before…{be01}
I’ve lost my confidence…
Maybe I’ll go home…

TRAINER_VIVI.name: Vivi
messages: Huh? Did I just lose?
This stinks…{be01}\n…Snivel… Grandma!

TRAINER_VIVIAN.name: Vivian
messages: With my charm and my Pokémon’s moves,\nyou’ll be shocked!{be01}
I’m shocked by your power!

TRAINER_WADE.name: Wade
messages: For Fishermen, equipment is the key.{be01}\nBut for Trainers, the key ingredients\nare Pokémon and heart, of course!{be01}
I was beaten in heart?
Come to think of it, fishing is a battle\nbetween a Fisherman and a Pokémon.

TRAINER_WALLACE.name: Juan

TRAINER_WALLACE_EMERALD.name: Wallace

TRAINER_WALLY_1.name: Wally
messages: Wow!\n{0100:0}, you are strong, after all!
Wally: I couldn’t beat you today,\n{0100:0}, but one of these days, I’ll{be00}\ncatch up to you!

TRAINER_WALLY_2.name: Wally
messages: Wally: Uncle…\nI’ll go back to Verdanturf…

TRAINER_WALLY_3.name: Wally
messages: Wow!\n{0100:0}, you are strong, after all!

TRAINER_WALLY_MAUVILLE.name: Wally
messages: Wally: Uncle…\nI’ll go back to Verdanturf…

TRAINER_WALLY_VR_1.name: Wally
messages: Wow!\n{0100:0}, you are strong, after all!
Wally: I couldn’t beat you today,\n{0100:0}, but one of these days, I’ll{be00}\ncatch up to you!

TRAINER_WALLY_VR_2.name: Wally
messages: Wow!\n{0100:0}, you are strong, after all!

TRAINER_WALTER_1.name: Walter
messages: Ah, well played.
I would like to circle the globe once\nagain with my Pokémon.

TRAINER_WALTER_2.name: Paxton
messages: Now where could my wife have gone?\nI’m always with her.{be00}\nI wonder if I can win on my own.{be01}
Ah, I see that I couldn’t manage\nto win on my own after all.
My wife must be looking for me.\nI’d best go find her right away.

TRAINER_WALTER_3.name: Isabella
messages: I’m not going to lose to some\nsurfer Trainer.{be01}
I’ve only got sweat in my eyes!\nI am not crying!
You can find pretty colored shards\nof things around here.

TRAINER_WALTER_4.name: Grunt
messages: Oh, will you look at my Pokémon?

Humph, so what?
What we want…{be01}
What we really want isn’t here…
Ihihihihi…

TRAINER_WALTER_5.name: Tabitha
messages: Hehehe…{be01}\nEven though I’ve lost, if our leader\nawakens that thing…
Boss, hurry!\nGive it the Meteorite’s energy!{be01}\nHehehe…

TRAINER_WARREN.name: Warren
messages: I want to win like everyone else, but I\nwon’t raise Pokémon like everyone else.{be01}
Darn it!\nMy way is still too slack!
It’s way more fun to do things the way\nI want than to be like everybody else.{be00}\nI mean, that’s obvious!

TRAINER_WATTSON.name: Wattson
messages:
Wahahahah!
Fine, I lost!{be01}
You ended up giving me a thrill!
Take this Badge!
I swell with optimism, seeing a promising\nyoung Trainer like you!

TRAINER_WATTSON_1.name: Wattson
messages:
Wahahahah!
Fine, I lost!{be01}
You ended up giving me a thrill!
Take this Badge!
I swell with optimism, seeing a promising\nyoung Trainer like you!

TRAINER_WAYNE.name: Wayne
messages: I want to visit Ever Grande, so I\ncaught myself a Pokémon that knows{be00}\nthe move Waterfall to crest the falls.{be01}
I’m crestfallen!
Awww, phooey!{be01}\nMy Pokémon knows Waterfall, but\nI don’t have the Sootopolis Gym Badge!

TRAINER_WENDY.name: Wendy
messages: Want to determine how strong you are?\nI’ll be the test!{be01}
You passed with flying colors!
To best even me…\nYour strength is marvelous!

TRAINER_WILL.name: Edwardo
messages: It was too much of a load for me\nto bear…

The world is huge, and there are
countless tough Trainers.{be01}
I’m going to keep training and make
myself even stronger.

TRAINER_WILLIAM.name: William
messages: I drown in self-pity…
My psychic powers have surely\ngrown several times, but…

TRAINER_WILTON_1.name: Wilton
messages: Show me how much you’ve toughened\nyour Pokémon.{be01}
I see, you’ve toughened them\nconsiderably.

Pokémon and Trainers learn much
through battling.{be01}
What’s important is to never give up
even if you lose.

TRAINER_WILTON_2.name: Grunt
messages: When I joined Team Aqua, the first\nthing I had to learn was how these{be00}\nwarp panels connected.{be01}
I was too occupied thinking about\nthe warp panels…
I’ll have to learn about how I can\nbattle more effectively…

TRAINER_WILTON_3.name: Fernando
messages: I’ll turn your lights out while\nI rip through this tune!{be01}
Hey, hold it!\nI was still playing the intro!
You’re rock steady.\nI’d like to write a tune about you.

TRAINER_WILTON_4.name: Jeff
messages: See how the flames blaze wildly?\nThey flare in anticipation of my win!{be01}
Something didn’t go right.
Well, so what? I say so what?\nI can walk on hot coals barefoot!{be01}\n…Don’t even think about trying it!

TRAINER_WILTON_5.name: Jace
messages: Come on, get with it!\nLet’s go before my feelings cool!{be01}
It’s so hot, and yet my heart is\nclutched by ice…
The way the battling spirit burns\nwithin you, you may stand a chance{be00}\nagainst our Leader.

TRAINER_WINONA.name: Winona
messages: Though I fell to you, I will remain\ndevoted to Bird Pokémon.

TRAINER_WINONA_1.name: Winona
messages: Though I fell to you, I will remain\ndevoted to Bird Pokémon.

TRAINER_WINSTON_1.name: Winston
messages: Oh, sure, I’ll accept your challenge.\nI have a lot of money.{be01}
Why couldn’t I win?
There are some things money can’t buy.\nThat’s Pokémon…

TRAINER_WINSTON_2.name: Jazmyn
messages: My confidence will get a boost by\nbeating someone obviously strong!{be01}
There goes my confidence…
They say that you can’t judge a person\nby their appearance.{be01}\nBut often, their looks don’t lie…

TRAINER_WINSTON_3.name: Jonas
messages: I lay in ambush, and a Trainer has\nlanded in my trap!{be01}
If you don’t lose, how am I supposed\nto have fun playing ninja?
I’m going to ambush a weaker-looking\nTrainer next time.

TRAINER_WINSTON_4.name: Kayley
messages: I just bought this parasol.\nMy cuteness should be up by a third!{be01}
You’re better than me by about\nfive times!
Using accessories effectively is\nthe secret behind fashion appeal.

TRAINER_WINSTON_5.name: Auron
messages: Hey! Was it you throwing garbage\ninto the sea?{be01}
Oh, you weren’t throwing trash into\nthe sea.

I found an unsightly bottle bobbing
in the waves earlier.{be01}
It angers me that someone would
pollute the sea!

TRAINER_WYATT.name: Wyatt
messages: Y-you want to battle with me?\nEven though I just caught my Pokémon?{be01}
Y-you’re all happy to win?\nEven though it’s only me?

Oh, so now you want to say a word to
the loser?{be01}
Aren’t you just the coolest?
Humph!

TRAINER_YASU.name: Yasu
messages: To lurk in shadows, and live in\ndarkness… That is my destiny.{be01}\nI emerge to challenge you!{be01}
I admit defeat!
Those defeated in battle withdraw\nquietly back into the shadows.{be00}\nThat, too, is destiny…

TRAINER_YUJI.name: Yuji
messages: Heh! Boulders like this, I can brush\naside with one finger!{be01}
I can push boulders, but I can’t solve\nthe puzzle…
It’s not good enough to be brawny…\nYou have to use your head. Be brainy!

TRAINER_ZANDER.name: Zander
messages: Kiyaaaaah!\nI’m terrified!{be01}
Nooooooo!\nI lost my wits!
I get freaked out every time I see\nanything move…{be01}\nI shouldn’t have come here to train…

TRAINER_ZANE.name: Gerald
messages: Can your Pokémon withstand\n392-degree heat?{be01}
It didn’t burn hotly enough…

The temperature of magma is
392 degrees.{be01}
Your Pokémon beat me, so they should
easily survive in magma.
